comments: Mike is a super host, was there to greet me and help me get settled in. Great communication from beginning of booking to departure, making sure I had everything I needed and acquainted me with the area. The apartment was lovely, exactly as presented on AirBnB, very European, clean, efficient, with everything and more I could need for a two week stay. The location was fabulous, just a block from Le Lac and the Jet eau and an easy walk to the Rive and Centre. I especially appreciated having a market just downstairs that had everything I needed, and a bus stop right outside the door. The apartment is located to the back of the building so very quiet for sleeping with no traffic noise. I highly recommend Mike's apartment to a single or couple traveling to Geneva.

The place is small but nice, located in relatively quiet area. The host is very friendly and helpful. He asked our questions quickly. A helpful and trustworthy person. It was an enjoyable experience for us.
Gaby's place is lovely. The location is so convient with the train station, grocery and lake near by. The bed was very comfortable. I would highly recomend it and would definitely stay here again.

Mike's apartment is the best! Location is perfect, two blocks from the lake and the jet d'eau, next to a supermarket and 5 minutes away from downtown Geneva (shops, restaurants, etc). The apartment has a lot of light, it's big and has everything you need! I highly recommend this place and plan to stay there again in the future! Thanks Mike for taking care of everything, and thanks Paulina for everything as well!

The apartment is as described and perhaps a bit bigger than the pictures depict. While we were there for a short period of time (2 nights), it would be an excellent place for a longer stay as it has a washer, cleaning supplies, large closet and many drawers, is right above a grocery store, and various bus lines are 1 minute away. So, easy transportation into the city. Can also walk. Great communication with Mike. Safe neighborhood, 10ish minute walk to Old Town, and a nice modern, clean apt.

This is the second time I stay with Lucia; she is a gracious and helpful host. The room and separate shower and toilet are comfortable and in immaculate condition. The location of the apartment is very convenient. I shall certainly be back.

Lucia was a very nice host and explained everything really well. The apartment was perfectly clean and quiet, very well located. In top of everything, the bed was super comfortable. I would definitely recommend to stay at her place.

I stayed with Lucia for just over a month when I first moved to Geneva. The space was exactly as advertised and made my transition to living in a new country incredibly smooth. Lucia was always an accommodating and communicative host. I enjoyed my stay with her I would recommend this listing to anyone!
Great host, Good place, worth the money. location depends on your work but for me it was good. had coop, McDonald's and migros nearby.

Had a lovely time staying with Oscar for a month, he is wonderful, really helpful and thoughtful. I would totally go back and stay anytime I'm back in Geneva, such a clean, tidy, easy going apartment, and a great room. The location is awesome, great chance for running by the river. Oscar is an excellent host, really enjoyed living with both him and Martin!
Very nice location next to everything, clean apartment, good and ease communication with the host.
Nice and clean cozy space. Maps points to the wrong place so make sure to pay attention to the street names.
The communication was very detailed and the studio is well situated in old town. I also used the washing machine in basement, which was very helpful. All in all perfect for a short stay!
Great apartment, nice spaces, very clean, and super close to the tram.
I had a wonderful stay! Everything was well organized and the apartment was just great!
Wonderful location that's hard to beat. I had a great stay and would highly recommend the apartment.

Warm and cozy studio, just what i needed for a weekend (but well equipped and could have stayed longer), so central in old town, building has lift, used to be a theatre. The cathedral bells are a backdrop. Bathtub, light (and blackout), and Eliora Elena is super easy to communicate with.
The place is very peaceful and quiet at night and morning, the building is well designed, the apartment is cozy, if you have a heavy suitcase it needs agood wheels because the roads are hard on them.

Iris is a very nice and attentive host. She made us feel very welcome at her house. It's well located and easy to find. The room is small but pretty and full of light. We had a good time and the breakfast was great.

This is my second stay at Hortense's apartment. I love it, so much better than a hotel but just as comfortable. She has a new bed which is wonderful, you are sure to get a good night's sleep. The place is tastefully decorated, the television even covered with a picture so if you just want to hang in the living room with a t.v. staring at you, you can. Very light and airy peaceful place to stay. She has the place equipped with a hair dryer, shampoo and all you would need in the kitchen. Location is very central with good restaurants with a few feet, plus grocery stores, excellent ice cream shops. Only a few blocks from the lake. Hortense was also flexible about check in and check out time, after long haul flight this is most welcome!

Hortense was very responsive and helpful. The space is really nice, and the location is great. A nice 15 minute walk from the UN buildings on the lake and right near many shops and restaurants. I highly recommended it.
The place was great and very close to the bus stop. The host was able to check us in early, she was really helpful!

Iris is a very warm host who truly cares about her guests' wellbeing in Geneva. She whips up a good breakfast for her guests every morning and never fails to greet everyone with a smile. I think my French has improved during my course of stay too - she was really nice to teach me some commonly used words and hopefully I can grasps them all in the time to come. The place is also cozy and a 20 min tram ride from the main city. If you are looking for a pleasant and homely stay in Geneva, do give Iris's home a go! :)

If you want a shelter where can satisfy your fantasy for attic of cozy house in Geneva, This house of Iris would be perfect place! And Iris and his husband are so kind and nice people. If you face the frustrating situation during the life in Geneva, they will help and guide you with careful supports. Also, Kitchen is always prepared with the tea and fruits. When you came back from outside, you can relax with hot tea and you can wake with beautiful bird's singing!

Very nice loft apartment, well furnished with interesting decor, and clean. Being on the top floor, and having windows opening in two directions gives rare glimpses to the lake and river, and allows for a good breeze and sense of space. Easy access to public transport - and walking distance to town. Immediate area is not the most exciting, although there are supermarkets nearby - but Geneva is small and easy to move around. Dave is very helpful and explains all you need to know in using the apartment.
Helena’s place is located in the heart of Geneva. Walking distance from all the main spots. The apartment is clean, well maintained and well equipped. Would definitely recommend it to anyone

We had a lovely stay at Helena's place. It was elegant, absolutely quiet, and bright, and it was easy to find and get in. Right outside is a bus that goes to the UN, the ecumenical center, and the main station. Helena responded to questions immediately. Overall a wonderful stay.
This is the second time we have stayed at one of Helena’s apartments. Always we feel at home, welcomed and looked after. Home away from home with a wonderful host.

The apartment was as described, very light, airy, clean, well equipped and perfectly situated for access to public transport. Miguel was very responsive even though he was not on site, and his son was waiting to greet us when we arrived. The apartment was very quiet despite the location and there was minimal neighbor noise from above or next door. There were hundreds of CDs DVDs and books and a high end stereo and TV system, a bit confusing to use but a set of instructions were available. The kitchen was well equipped with nice plates, glasses etc and a few basic items were available if one wanted to cook. There were plenty of restaurants and take away places nearby. We would happily return to chez Miguel and recommend it for business or leisure travelers.

Really nice apartment where I feel like at home. Living room is cosy with a stylish furniture. Bedroom is very quiet. Easy to come to with tram 14. Shops and restaurants are near the building. I really recommend Dave's apartment.
Everything was wonderful. A beautiful and sophisticated apartment in a great location. The owners are great hosts and very accessible and accommodating. They also have good taste and style.

The flat was great. Very comfortable and clean. We had bed linen and towels available. The apartment looks very nice and the open place area is great. It has all the kitchen appliances you might need. There are very big windows in the open place area that lets plenty of light in. Miguel was very helpful and communication was great. We had no problems checking in or out. Everything was very straightforward. The place is really close to the station and it takes less than 10 mins to get to the Airport. Having wifi at the flat was also very helpful too.

Dave's place was wonderful and cozy. Very conveniently located and close to local transit. Beautifully decorated if you are looking for some MCM style ideas. Clear check-in instructions and responsive communication. I'd recommend Lahore restaurant down the street, some of the best butter chicken I've had but ask them to make it spicy!

I stayed with Lucia for 10 days. Lucia is kind, gentle and gracious host and I enjoyed very much my stay with her. My room is fully furnished and the apartment itself is very clean and tidy. Plus, the location is very convenient and I didn't have problems finding my way around Geneva. I also enjoyed the few times chatting with Lucia and learning something from her. I hope that in my next visit to Geneva, I will be able to stay with Lucia again. Thanks so much Lucia! - Kathy

I had guests from abroad so they were in Lucas apartment. The place is great, just as described and even better. Lucas is most attentive host who is interested in your needs before you come, so when you arrive all is in perfect order. I am fully recommending his place. Thank you for everything!!!!😀

The apartment overall is very beautiful and accurately represented. The space is very large and the commodities offered made the stay very hassle free. Pedro responded very quickly to questions and booking as well as made the apartment immediately available.
We enjoyed our stay at the White apartment, it was nicely decorated, fairly convenient and comfortable.

Quiet apartment in a great location. Henrique is a really interesting and hardworking guy, speaking several languages and generelly being very helpful. The room was clean and comfortable. I look forward to my next stay!

Henrique deserves the 5 star feedback . His room is clean. The amenities are all confortable and clean. The point is he is really helpful in giving advices to the tour in Geneva. As a new comer at airbnb, I am afraid that the stay might bring stress to me as it raise my expectations for my future stays at other rooms.
I had a fantastic stay at Henrique's place! The space is nice, the location is excellent, and Henrique is very welcoming. I would highly recommend staying here!

I would highly recommend this apartment. It appears exactly as the host described it. It is very close to town, and very quiet. I am a fan of anything white and really appreciated the decor. Pierre looks like we have the same taste. Thank you.

Lovely place. Very comfortable and clean. Great location. Pierre gave very clear instructions on how to get in and was quick to respond to questions. The building facade is being renovated but I was out during the day so I didn’t hear any construction noise. Will definitely stay there again!

Whether its inviting you to a home cooked dinner with his friends to providing helpful tips about the city, Henrique will make you feel right at home in Geneva. The flat is spacious with a fully stocked kitchen, common area, and two restrooms. The bedrooms also have all the furnishings you'll need. Would definitely recommend!

Dunja was a very accommodating host, making last-minute arrangements so we would be more comfortable and giving us print-outs of the bus schedule, which we had been unable to access online. The apartment is a chic music- design- and book-lover's dream in a beautiful country-side setting. We were there on a holiday weekend, but found a charming restaurant with a good cook at less than 10 minutes walk away, so didn't have to cook every meal. All in all a wonderful place to stay.

The apartment is just as described, all that you would require... The location for us was just perfect, a few mins from Lake Geneva, an easy drive round the lake to Lausanne, and up into the Alps.. Spectacular... Banna is a very nice and friendly host, loving a couple of doors along in the same apartments, always on hand for some valuable local knowledge, and made sure our stay was a happy one... Banna also left lots of goodies in the fridge for us to use and fresh flowers on our arrival... I would like to say that although the apartment had an oven, a microwave would be an added welcome addition....
It was comfortable and located close to a bus line that we used to get around the city.
Fantastic communicator, great location, easy access to the park, great for long term stay as I did, nice area, and well equipped kitchen.
Lucia is a great host, very friendly and informative. The flat is very well kept, clean, everything well organised. Absolutely recommendable!

Arnaud was a great host, very accommodating and welcoming. The apartment is lovely, recently refinished in a modern and very functional way, with a kitchen that has everything you could possibly need, The apartment is well located in old town with several cafes and restaurants close by.

Wow, what an incredible host and place to stay in Geneva. Peter was a true superstar - welcoming, friendly, and his apartment is a beautiful space. The space has lots of great light, loads of space, friendly cats (Gin and Tonic), a mega comfy bed, a great shower and a perfect location to walk everywhere in Geneva. I loved the fact that Peter devoted time to getting to know his guests - a true model of what Airb&bs started to be ...... and should be. His home is your home. I would definitely recommend staying here in Geneva, and I will be back again.

Great location in the heart of Old Town Geneve. Walking distance to many shops, museums, the St Pierre cathedral, restaurants and bars. The space is exactly as depicted in the photos, very comfortable and clean. Check in was very easy and Francois's communication before our trip was clear and responsive. A note for anyone with large, heavy luggage or traveling with small children - this flat is located on the second floor, although there is an elevator/lift it is small…you may just need to be prepared to make several trips!

We really appreciated Francoise's attentiveness to detail and responsiveness to our requests. We loved the flat and location in Old Towne. Very easy to get to the flat from the airport and to walk around Geneve. Thanks Francoise!

If you are going to Geneva, stay with Jean-Philippe and Xioung. They are highly warm and gracious hosts and made us feel very welcome and like family. They provided us with a lot of information about Geneva that enhanced our visit. Their home is conveniently located near the train station and the lake and is beautifully and tastefully decorated with artifacts from Southeast Asia. The bedroom and bath we used were extremely comfortable and clean. Both our hosts have led interesting lives, which they generously shared to our happy enjoyment. They were so much fun and so charming. We hope to meet them again someday.

Francoise's apartment was the perfect place for me to stay while I was working in Geneva. The bed was comfortable, the WiFi quick and reliable, the area ideal and the whole stay enjoyable. A perfect Airbnb experience!

We had an outstanding experience. Jean-Philippe couldn't have been warmer and more helpful--it was like having our own personal tour guide to Geneva, a city he obviously loves. The accommodations were spotless and beautiful, and exceptionally well located--less than a five minute walk from the train station, and then less than another five minutes to the lake. We walked everywhere--along the lake, to the UN area, through Old Town--guided by the audio tours Jean-Philippe provided. We were also a half block away from Parfums de Bayreuth, a highly rated and delicious (and affordable) place for Lebanese food. So glad we found this place!
The room is so clean and comfortable, location is convenient, very close to train station. The host is nice and polite. For sure, we will choose here again if we visit Geneva.

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Jean-Philippe and Xuong's place. They deserve all the positive reviews. Our flight was delayed and Xuong was so accommodating despite how late our arrival was (nearly midnight)! Also they loaned me an adapter so we could charge our phones. Highly recommended!

I would highly recommend this accommodation when visiting Geneva. It is a 3 min walk from the main train station and about 10-15 min from the city centre by foot. It was very clean and SECURE which was a big thing for us. Felt very safe staying in this accommodation and would definitely stay here again.

Absolutely amazing room in a fabulous location. Thank you both for the fantastic cozy room, speedy responses and help with exploring (and eating in) the city. We plan to visit your amazing city again soon, and will definitely stay at your place.

Ranya is a wonderful host, always quick to respond and helpful with any questions related to our stay. The place is in a modern housing complex, with the cleanest bathroom and well-maintained furniture and equipment. It’s a short walk from the bus station and has multiple supermarkets and restaurant options nearby.

Very well located in the old town district. Plenty to see and do within a very short walk. Main station is only 10-12 minutes walk. The famous fountain isn’t far. Plenty of restaurants. Thai massage available on the ground floor if you’ve had a hard days travelling. Easy to find once you have worked out the numbering system of the square - odd numbers on one side, even on the other. Apartment located on the lower side of the square. I’m sure you will enjoy your stay.

Xuong and Jean-Philipe were most accommodating not only to meeting me on arrival but also for my departure when I wanted a quick tour of CERN after checkout time. They have a great location that is within walking distance of most anywhere with great views of the city.

It is clean, quite large single room with modern bathroom and small kitchen. The bed was comfortable. A washing machine is helpful. Near to a Co-op, 3 minutes down the hill to bus stop . Nearby many restaurants and in the Old Town so plenty of interesting history to explore. I arrived a little early and this was OK with Philippe. He responded quickly to all my (few) messages. Only small problem is you need the windows closed at night to sleep because of the people who seem to congregate outside the building talking loudly all night!
Amazing place and amazing location! Super close to the train and the lake! It was a pleasure to stay here
Good location. We only had the chance to meet Philippe. He’s very friendly and kind. Make us feel like being at home. Highly recommend.
Such great hosts, very welcoming and made check in very easy! Great location and good value for money Thank you for the lovely stay :)
Erika and Nacer were both great hosts. Always there for you if you need anything. Place has good view from the windows. Would recommend to stay here.

It was a great place. I had the instruction to access the flat before my travel date and had no difficulty finding the place and accessing my room. All the instruction were clear. I could contact Isi and get response quickly if I had any query. The place was clean and quiet. Was very close to the Geneva train station and superstore Migros. Isis made efforts to meet me in person and I really appreciate that. Overall I would say a very good value for money.
This was a great place to stay, it was easily accessible to the train and bus station. The host was very accommodating and made our stay very enjoyable. We would highly recommend.

Philippe and Xu are excellent hosts! Philippe met us when we arrived and had already thought of an itinerary of things to see during our short stay (2 nights). They were friendly and have us plenty of space and privacy. The room was very well maintained and the bed comfortable and had fresh, clean linens. The bathroom is huge and the shower is great--they provided all the little things to make our stay easy, including a power plug adapter, as we forgot ours. A great first airbnb experience for us. The toilet is not in the room, but is nearby the exit door and anyway the route from the room to the toilet is private enough--it was not a problem at all for us.

Jean Philippe and Xuong were waiting for us when we arrived and greeted us like we were a member of the family. During our whole visit they made us feel right at home. We really did enjoy staying in their apartment. They provided all the amenities that we ever could have wanted. We really did appreciate their providing the audio guides for Geneva. That really did make a difference in our being able to enjoy the city. The location of the apartment could not have been better. Jean Philippe was a storehouse of information for seeing the city. Overall it was an excellent experience.

Upon booking our trip, both Jean-Philippe and Xuong we're very helpful with providing all the necessary information that we needed prior to arriving in Geneva. The instructions to their place was very clear and easy to follow. It was great to know that we were 5 mins away from the train station and was close to restaurants and stores. We were given a very warm welcome and our questions we're always answered if we had any. We decided to stay one more night in Geneva and luckily they were able to accommodate us. We felt at home and very comfortable with Jean-Philippe and Xuong and would highly recommend to anyone visiting Geneva to give them a shot.
Philippe and Elzbieta’s hospitality and communications are outstanding. The accomodation are perfectly fit for 3 of us. Those made our stay in Geneva a wonderful experience. Thanks a lot guys!

Located in the centre of Geneva, Jean-Phillipe & Xuong's place is the perfect place to explore the city from! Jean-Phillipe and Xuong were fantastic hosts and will make sure that you get to experience the best of Geneva! Highly recommended!

A fun and comfortable space! Although the room (actually room with private bathing/showing/sink--shared toilet just adjacent outside the room) is a piece of a whole apartment (as stated in the listing), I rarely ran into my good hosts at all. They were careful to guard my privacy completely. The location is about three minutes from the Cornavin Train Station (the main/Center train station in Geneva), so catching the tram for getting to my work was a snap. And even on Sunday when Geneva stores pretty much close down, the train station grocery store, drugstore, and other shops are open for business. The room is a kind of attic add-on in and older apartment building, with exposed beams (watch your head!), but I found it very sympatico and comforting. I would stay here again for sure. Thanks!

The house is well-located near downtown Geneva. The host was very responsive and kind. Everything you need when traveling is all in the house. The house is well organized and equipped. It was very good place to stay. I recommend this house very strongly to everyone who plans to visit Geneva.
Everything was great! I really recommend this place. The flat is gorgeous and good lokalization.
Superb location: quiet but still close to public transportation, supermarkets, pharmacy, post office. The apartment was very clean and stylish, and the view from the balcony is very nice.
The apartment is well equipped with plenty of space and very clean. The neighborhood was quiet and residential.

Mauricio is absolutely awesome. He is very kind, friendly, and helpful. I came to Geneva with very few plans and he told me about a ton of things that I can do. His place is clean, easy to get to, and in a very central location in Geneva. 5-stars without a doubt. The room is very nicely decorated. Overall, I would highly recommend staying.
Mauricio's place got everything we could have asked for and more. The place has been such a great stay that we regret leaving. Truly a place that fulfill our vacation.

I have stayed in this apartment on numerous occasions. Viona is very warm and responsive. The apartment has a great balcony and view overlooking a lovely park, which is particularly nice in the summer. It's very bright and full of natural light. It's right next to the bus stop for the airport, so very easy to get there and get back. You are about a ten minute walk from the train station and you can get the tram from only over the road into the city centre. Recommended!
Lovely, light studio flat. Number 5 bus brings you to the door from the airport. Supermarket, pharmacy & restaurants are 1 minute away. Viona responds quickly and helpfully. Couldn’t be better.
Nice clean apartment, well located and with all the facilities as advertised.

Mauricio's place is very easily accessible: a minutes walk to the lake and to the train station. The neighbors we met were friendly and helpful. The area had so many cute shops and delicious smelling restaurants. The most notable thing about this stay was the excellent communication! Check-in, checkout, and miscellaneous questions were well conveyed. The apartment itself was clean and had the touches of home. I would definitely stay here again and recommend anyone I know coming to Geneve to stay here as well! Thank you so much!
The location is perfect! The apartment is so nice, clean, and well stocked with essentials. Communication from the host was great. Would definitely stay again!

Mauricio's apartment is perfect for those visiting the city! It was great for my partner and I as we visited for a few days. We loved how close it was to everything and even though it was super hot, we were able to stay cool with the help of Mauricio's fans. I would highly suggest staying here and will absolutely be coming back!

I highly recommend Mauricio's studio to other travellers. It is very conveniently located, close to the Geneva train station. It is well equipped and very comfortable. It is quiet (no noise from neighbours and it is away from the street) and cosy - I felt very at home and plan to stay again soon! Thank you, Mauricio, for a great stay!

We had a lovely stay in Ioan’s apartment. We are a family of 5 with a child who has special dietary needs, and could not find a hotel that could cater to our needs. Ioan’s apartment is a real family home and was perfect for what we needed - a little more space and a kitchen! Even though the apartment is in a residential area, it is centrally located and near the Jet D’Eau, Baby Plage and many shops and restaurants. We easily walked from Old Town and central Geneva to the apartment with 3 young children. Ioan also went out of his way to look after us and ensure we had everything we needed even though he was on holiday. We very much enjoyed our stay and would recommended for families!

I had one night in Mauro's flat and it was ideal. It was easy to find, a short walk from the WHO, and it was very clean, spacious and comfy. Whilst I didn't meet Mauro (all was arrange on text) he was very easy to get on touch with and he checked up on me to make sure I had everything I needed. My first air BnB experience and a very good intro! Thanks a lot Mauro

This apartment was perfect for my trip - 15 min walk from the WHO/UN organisations, supermarket nearby, it is a bright and clean apartment in a quiet neighbourhood. Mauro was very communicative and helpful, although we did not meet in person. I would highly recommend it and would certainly stay again if I had reason to be in that part of town.

Mauro is a good host, he's very friendly, he checked if everything was OK, he's easy to contact and he replies quickly. The studio was spacious, clean, and well equipped with everything you need for your stay. The area is quiet and shops, restaurants, and the bus stop are in walking distance. Next time I'm in Geneva I'll book this one again!

Everything is perfect! The neighborhood is very quite. The place is very close to the bus station and there are some good restaurants and a supermarket near around. I had a good stay at Mauro's studio.
The apartment was as described and conveniently located between Gare Cornavin and the lakeshore.

The apartment was nicer than the photos. The bed was large and comfy with many pillows. It was stocked nicely to cook in, having all the amenities as listed. Mauricio was also a responsive and friendly host. We had a fine stay, and I would recommend it to others.

Great location. The apartment has a living room combined with a kitchen, and a separate bedroom. The bathroom is in two separate spaces: there is a toilet (no shower) accessible from the living room and a shower (no toilet) accessible from the bedroom. The host made all the appropriate arrangements via a third person. We enjoyed our stay.

Great location surrounding the international organizations (UN etc.) Apartment had everything you need! AC would be great (mainly for summer months!) Mario is super lovely and flexible to your needs!!
I'm very happy to stay with basma everything as it announced in Airbnb and the location is very close to nation the room is very big and comfortable the area is quiet next time i will stay there

My stay at Basma’s place went really well. She was extremely accommodating, since I arrived a bit past midnight and she waited up for me. Her place is really nice and convenient to the downtown area and train system. She made me feel right at home and was a wealth of information regarding potential places to visit. Do not hesitate to stay Chez Basma!!

Basma is an excellent host, very responsive by message, very clear directions on how to get to the apartment. The place is close to 14, 18 tram station, close to cafes restaurants and supper markets. Thank you for the welcome and I highly recommend this peaceful accommodation and good value for money.

Bianca and her brother are nice people and I did not have any serious problem with them or the room I stayed in. I do not speak French, but it seems to me that the family speaks Portuguese, so, I was able to come by with my Spanish. Although the language barrier the communication was easy. It is true, that they do not lock the apartment and I did not have a key to my room either. This might be a cultural/Swiss thing. There was a party one evening in the apartment, but it finished at 23:00 as Bianca and her brother promised, OK for me. All around fine for a short stay.

The hosts are very nice and friendly. The room is clean and the bed is comfortable. If you sleep very late, you may need to keep your voice down as it could disturb the host's sleeping time. Other than that, I would recommend staying at this place! = ]

Rebecca's place is really great. Near to public transport, nice neighborhood, a big and we'll furnished room as well as the common areas. She's a super kind host and I will definitely recommend her place to stay in Geneva.

I really recommend this apartment. Brilliant location in the heart of Geneva. Close to main sightseeing, shops, cafes and bars. The best place to discover the city and walk around. Historical building and cozy apartment.  You can find everything you need inside (and even more). One thing you should consider is not enough hot water for three adults at the same time (waterheating in the apartment). Lena is a friendly and kind host. She was online anytime ready to help and gave many useful recommendations. I really appreciate for this.

I spend one week at Lena's place while on a conference. The apartment is nicely located in the city center, with shops and restaurants around. It is just 2' away from the bus/tram stop which makes it very convenient. Lena's place is spacious and it has a functional kitchen. Lena was very responsive and check in and out was easy. Overall a good a experience.
We loved it, the apartment was perfect. Breakfast was great, and the staff were very helpful.

Can’t beat this location! The flat is great space. Lena made check in and check out very easy and was very communicative. I had everything I needed. I did not cook or use the kitchen so I can’t speak to that, but everything else was great!

Although we did not meet in person, Van was a great host. His communication was excellent, and he was very accomodating with our uncertain time schedule, being very flexible with late check in as well as late check out options. The apartment was comfortable for two couples, and the location could not be more convenient to the main train station.

Excellent stay! Van is really helpful by giving a clear instructions on how to get to the apartment and since he is also travelling at the moment he provides other friends contact numbers so that we can get in touch shoukd there's any emergency. Great house. Very convenient since its so near train station.
It's so nice less than a minute from the city center and all things you need just next to you

Van is very responsive, the guide book he sent before is quite informative. I forgot he sent me the details for checking in but everything was fine. We didn’t use the kitchen, except for some hot water and nice tea. There are some nice restaurants nearby and it is quite close to the city center(if I remembered correctly). It was overall a pleasant stay.
nice location and apartment. van was very communicative. I recommend reading the instructions throughly lol

Excellent location, good amenities, spacious, clean, well-stocked with useful things either provided by the owner or left behind by previous guests such as washing liquid, electrical power adapters, etc. Excellent value for money and would definitely stay here again.

The apartment/ flat was exactly as described and everything from check in to check out was super easy and smooth. I highly recommend this apartment for both its cleanliness, large size and the professionalism of the hosts. I will certainly try to rent this again next time I am in Geneva.
The flat is really clean and the location is perfect! ( 5mins walk from the train station)

I really appreciate everything. The house is about 5 min of the airport, it is very close to good restaurants and the tram station. It is a very beautiful and clean house. Fabrice, the owner of the house is very welcome and made us feel really confortable and even introduced us to very good person :). I enjoyed a lot and for sure will stay at the same house when go back to Geneve.

The apartment is better than it looks in the pictures, very clean, with a location that is both central in a neighborhood that can provide anything but quiet at the same time so you can relax and enjoy your stay. What's more, the apartment's host was always easy to reach, eager to help us with anything and truly made our experience in Geneva even greater! Would for sure visit again!
Great location in the old town. Very convenient. Clean, spacious and comfortable. We enjoyed our stay.
Very convenient location and had all the ameniies needed. Great position for the Geneva Motor show.
Great apartment and spacious for our family of 5. Christine was very helpful and provided all instructions clearly. The apartment was close to everything.
Water facility in shower was low pressure and old. Electricity old and needs repair. But a large and spacious place. In the middle of everything. Balcony and and large bathrooms.
Excellent location and space. We were three couples and had ample privacy. Excellent for group or family who need just the basics.
This place is HUGE! Basically 3 apartments in one. It was perfect for our family of 5 and right in the walkable distance to great shops and town. Truly couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

Everything was great except busy street. At night it may be noisy, especially in hot weather when you'd like to have window open. For people visiting CERN the location is perfect (half an hour walk thru parks and fields). Also, the espresso machine is a bonus!

This is a great place to book in Geneva - excellent value for money in a very expensive city! We were there for work so the extra space of dining room and living room gave us plenty of space in which to meet with colleagues. I would highly recommend this apartment for a stay in Geneva. The location is also excellent and convenient to public transportation which makes traveling around the city easy and to/from the airport a breeze.

A fantastic large and airy 2 bedroom apartment situated in the heart of old Geneva. Christine was a super host. She provided fast and informative responses to our email questions and went out of her way to introduce herself and make our stay enjoyable. The apartment has everything needed for a short or long stay; including a fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, dishwasher and a large sunny lounge and dining areas. The old town is right on the door step and a large supermarket only 5 minutes walk away. The apartment itself is part of the hotel, so check-in/out is very easy and open extended hours. Would thoroughly recommend! Thanks.
My colleagues had the pleasure of staying at Laurent's place for a recent conference. The location was perfect and it was a good size for a group of colleagues.

The apartment was everything we could have hoped for. Four of us stayed for a long weekend and the central location was perfect for us to explore this beautiful city. The small balcony was perfect for coffee in the morning and wine in the evening. There was more space than expected so we could spread out and relax after a long day of walking. It was very hot in Geneva while we were there so the air conditioning was very much appreciated. The service was also excellent with easy check in and check out and daily service. It was also very secure with key access. I highly recommend to families or anyone that wants a quiet and comfortable place to stay in the center of everything.
It's really near to the train station as well as other transportation means and the lake. Laurent's place is wonderful!

This apartment is a great option for larger groups; we had seven people staying comfortably. The facilities are excellent, with a fully equipped kitchen for those who prefer to cook. Cleaning service is available twice a week, and the staff are helpful and responsive. Another advantage is that the apartment is located right next to a FlixBus stop, which is convenient for travelers arriving from or heading to other countries such as France, Italy, and beyond.
Everything perfect! The place is great, everything clean everyday and the location is perfect!

Fantastic apartment in a perfect location — everything was within easy walking distance, including the lake and the old town. The apartment met all our expectations and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and would happily recommend it to others.

Initially the room had not been ready to check-in for a few hours which was a slight inconvenience but we were able to drop our luggage off. The hot water also did not work for half a day but Phillipe was able to have it fixed for later that night. Good location to everything and walking downtown among shops and restaurants.

I had a great stay at Aline's family's home. The apartment was clean and warm, well-located with good wifi. Aline wasn't in at the time I arrived, but she made every effort to put me in touch with her family and to help me find the flat. I was visiting for work, so I didn't really have a chance to be sociable, but I had a warm welcome and good stay.

Diane and Bertrand are really great. I arrived early and they were very considerate. The room was really great, I slept incredibly well. I really liked that the window opened all the way and let in a lot of sunlight which was nice when I had to be on remote work phone calls. The neighborhood is also really nice, a real neighborhood but still only a 10 minute walk to the city center.

Diane s place is at a good location, close to a supermarket. The house is clean, well decorated, has everything you need. And Diane respond very fast, and her husband open the door for us who is super nice. Diane's place is 100% recommended. Sure I will stay at her place if I visited Geneve again.

There was some hiccups checking in, but Philippe was very prompt to respond to the issues. The apartment is in a great location, near restaurants, art galleries, shops, and other places of interest. The apartment was clean and had the essentials. It is quite a climb up to the apartment, so if 5 flights of stairs is intimidating you may want to consider that.
The room is comfortable and the host is very nice 👍 I recommend this room!

Henrique was an extremely responsive host and was very accommodating. The place is ideal for meetings at the UN and was safe, private and well maintained. I would highly recommend this place and Henrique as a great Host!

Ben was a tremendous host. Although unable to be there to greet us, he had full instructions for us and it was very easy. The flat only fits 2 people comfortably, maybe 3 in a pinch. Overall great location, 5 minute walk to the lake. I highly recommend.
I highly recommend this place. Isi and his wife are kind and helpful. The location is convenient to the train station and downtown.
This property is particularly good value for money and is in a great location, close to the station. The host Isi is so kind and welcoming, feel free to ask him,he is always there .

Perfectly located - couldn't be nearer to the train station. Great price, comfy bed, good night's sleep. It's not a top luxury space but it does the trick with charm and was a pleasure to chat with Isi. Recommended!

Ben made checking in easy. Communication was straightforward and we arranged a time to meet upon my arrival from the airport. Place is as shown in photos. Location is fantastic. 2 mins from train station.

Staying at Ben's place was absolutely wonderful and I highly recommend it! It is a beautiful, small apartment that is perfect for a single traveller or a couple who are in Geneva for work or holidays. Ben was a great host in each step, from communicating how to get the keys to providing coffee and amenities and checking in with me throughout the week. The apartment is super central, 2 min walk to Gare Cornavin, 10 min to the lake and 10 min to the UN area. Travelers should be aware of the street noise but for me this was not a problem, most of it goes away when the window is closed. I hope to stay here again when I'm in town next time.

Ben’s apartment is great. One block from Cornavin Train Station, easy to walk everywhere, great food in the neighborhood. It is perfect for a stay in Geneva. Ben was great, he responded promptly to my messages, instructions were easy and clear, check in and check out a breeze. Would definitely stay here again during my next visit to Geneva!
Great location! Isi is super friendly and communicative ! Let me use the laundry and very flexible . Clean place with all provided amenities!
Great place close to the train station! Isi was also very responsive and flexible. Highly recommend!

Ania's apartment is very clean, beautiful and comfortable. The bedroom has a king size bed for customer. And it is very easy to find and convennient to the train station. Ania is a nice, lovely and enthusiasm girl. She give us lots of informaition. We feel lucky to spend honeymoon vacation at her apartment.

Studio with additional (small) single bedroom located in stunning old building in city center, next to the cathedral. Tastefully furnished and clean. Air conditioning was highly appreciated. Kitchen is well equipped with coffee machine for which nespresso capsules were provided. Lots of storage space. Check-in and communication with host flawless.
Marc’s place was amazing. Great location to the amazing old town and beautifully furnished. Would definitely like to stay again. Great communication as well

Absolutely stunning place, very few times do the photos actually match the place but this apartment was amazing. Had everything needed and a gorgeous view as well as one of the best locations to be at in Geneva. All of the nicest restaurants and alleys are walkable and the Alabama Room is only a 5 minute walk away. The place was spotless and amazingly cozy. Highly recommend!!!!

Philippe and Alexandra were very warm and friendly hosts! Their house was clean and quiet. The location is perfect! Only couple minutes walk from Gare Cornavin in the center of the city making it very easy to get around the city and to any other cities in Switzerland or France. I highly recommend their place!

Great hosts! Very kind and attentive and gave a lot of recommendations as to where to shop for groceries of food I could eat (I have a restrictive diet) and go around town. They left a space for me in the refrigerator. The room was very clean and comfortable, in an extremely convenient location right across the main train station. Thanks!
Very cute apartment at a perfect location 2 minutes from the lake. Very Clean, Bright and comfortable with a new bathroom and kitchen.

this was a very nice clean and spacious room. The host is very friendly and helpful but still provide all the space you require when you stay in an airbnb. i would stay here again. the location was close to the busses and and several small shopping centre's

Marie was ana amazing host. I've been there for work and stayed at her house for 10 days. Her apartment is so close to the bus station Arare which goes to the city centre. Comfortable place, well equipped. I liked the balcony :) She was so kind and drop me to the airport this morning :) Recomend 😊

I had a lovely stay at Urs's place in Geneva. It is a perfect location, perfectly quiet yet just a short walk from UN offices and the city center and all amenities are in walking distance. Communicating with Urs was easy and he was always available to help. Thank you for the stay :)

Amy has a really great apartments in the very nice area in Geneva!! There is a bus and a tram stop just next to the apartments, but almost everything could be reached in a walking distance so you don't really need to use public transport. The apartments are very clean and cute and you can find everything you need there! Communicating with Amy was also easy - she helped me a lot and responded all of my questions! I would definitely recommend to stay in Amy's apartments!

Amy's apartment is beautiful and spacious. It was great to arrive there in the evening after a whole day of driving and feel a bit like 'coming home'. Especially taking a hot shower with 'enough pressure' (what I missed at the place I stayed at before) was such a good treat! Only problem was the slightly too loud location. A tram is going by in the street quite often and you can hear that very well throughout the whole apartment...so if you have a light sleep, remember to bring some earplugs! Communication with Amy was always easy and quick and although she wasn't there at my arrival, the key was easy to find and I didn't have any problems.
Amy's apartment was great, and very much enjoyed the area -- much nicer and livelier than other parts of Geneva. Thanks!
Amy's place was very nice and clean. Very close to the tram stop, near shops and in the city center.

Pierre's place is perfect! It's exactly as beautiful as the photos suggest and it has plenty of room for relaxing, dining, etc. It's quiet because it's at the top of the building and it gets gorgeous sunlight all day with huge windows on both sides. Close to the UN buildings and great public transport connections to others places of interest in Geneva. Pierre was super easy to communicate with, access was simple - I was even left some dinner for my first night. Very highly recommended!!

We loved Sandrine’s home! Full of beautiful art work and located at an easy walking distance from the train station and the water front. Awesome for kids as there are bunk beds and a play room. We also loved Remo Pizza across the street and the Coop grocery store is an easy walking distance away.

We stayed 2 nights with Sandro and everything went really well. To begin with he went and picked me up from the station so I wouldn't get lost which was a very nice gesture. Then I was offered fresh tomatoes from his garden. The room was big and comfortable and the house super quiet because of the huge garden around it. Breakfast was also great. Overall we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Mike's place is perfect for anyone who is traveling by train in Geneva, right across the street from the station. Very clean and loved the coffee and sparkling water station in the lobby.
The communication was great, public transport right in front of the door. Jeanette welcomed me very friendly. Cosy and clean room, I let very good, even it was a bit noisy.

Jeanette was very pleasant, communicative, and a great host. I would highly recommend her. The room was exactly as advertised -- simple, but very convenient for a short stay near the center of Geneva with easy airport access using public transport.

Moe's place is quite lovely, it's easy to see that he takes good care of it. The localization is really nice, close to the station and the city center. I really recommend this place for your stay in Geneva !

Moe was very welcoming and met me in person and walked me through the apartment. Everything was as mentioned in the listing and everything was super central. Will definitely be back if I'm in Geneva again!

I cannot compliment this place and its hosts enough. It is perfect place to relax and feel comfortable. Although a little distant from the centre, transport links are extremely easy and convenient. But above all, I received the warmest of welcomes from Irène and Christoph.

This place is wonderful! The layout of the apartment is spacious and the balcony is lovely. Louis is very responsive and a really nice guy. The bed is a pullout, but comfortable enough. The kitchen and living areas are all very nice. The flat is in a residential area of town and the main train station is easily accessible. I would highly recommend staying here.

Very clean and nice place with view of the mountains. Elena's team is great and very attentive, and they maintain good communication with the guests. I stayed there for a month and had a very good experience. The check in experience was also great as they were extremely accommodating. I highly recommend this place. It is close to the center and public transportation is very convenient.
Louis has been extremely helpful! The apartment is calm and well connected by public transport.

Vladimir is a great host. Answered questions quickly. The location of the apartment is great with several cafes and grocery store near by. The train runs right across the street so great to move around. Geneva is a beautiful city and our stay at Vladimir's apartment was perfect!

Sandro is an exceptional host. He keeps a very clean house, has a beautiful yard, and made us breakfast in the morning. Had grocery and restaurants nearby. The house and neighborhood was very peaceful and pleasant with lots of street parking for cars.

Perfect stay -- the place was just as advertised, a nice, clean, quiet apartment. All the essentials were there, and it's in a nice location near a few restaurants (the Vietnamese and Eritrean ones were good) and very close to the tram line. Kwene (Neema's sister) welcomed me in and showed me the apartment and was very kind and helpful! Strongly recommend....

Mila was a very accommodating host. She was prompt in her replies as we traveled to Geneva, and she also made sure to leave clear instructions on how to do things, as well as recommendations for things to do nearby. The flat was clean, just as advertised, and in a GREAT location. Highly recommend.
Clemence is extremely kind landlord and the apartment is well located and clean

Ludovica is an excellent host! Not only is the apartment in an amazing location and a great value for money, but her kind hospitality also helps you to feel at home during your stay. I very much appreciated having my own space with access to common areas as well. I highly recommend this place and would certainly come back for another visit.
We loved staying here! The street gets quite loud at night, but it’s great if you’re wanting to grab a drink or hang out. Clémence was kind and communicated well! Would definitely stay here again.

We loved staying at Clemence’s place in Geneva. It was convenient, close to public transportation, clean and the perfect place for a few days stay. Clemente was responsive, helpful and kind. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Getting into the flat was so easy- despite there being a few different steps, Clémence took pictures of everything and was incredibly descriptive about how to unlock the gate, get the key, and get inside. Our wifi ended up going out on the second day but she was very responsive when I messaged her and let us use her personal wifi. We never waited long for a response and she was very friendly. The area was a little noisy but honestly I expected worse because of the other reviews. We slept just fine! The kitchen and bathroom were spotless, the beds were very nice, and overall it was a lovely stay.

I had a great stay at Clemence Airbnb. It was exactly how she described it. The apartment is perfectly located with all of the restaurants close by and is easy to commute into the city or if you prefer a morning run along the lake. I definitely would recommend it for anyone wanting to visit Geneva.

Chantal's apartment stands out for its comfortable large bed (convertible sofa), thoughtful decoration, its closeness to the Pont-Céard train station and the absolutely wonderful view on Lake Geneva. But all this is outshined by the hostess's wonderful hospitality - she is really going to great lengths to ensure her guest's comfort and happiness - many many thanks for that! A bientôt!

Chantal is a wonderful host. She is warm, resourceful and ready to go to extreme lengths to assist you during your stay. Her place is just a two-minute walk from the Pont-Céard stop from which you can get to Geneva center by train in just 15 minutes. The flat has a superb view on the lake and all what you need to enjoy a laid-back stay after a long working day. Perfect place for leisure or business.
No noise if the window is closed. Comfortable and clean, decent location, close to many nice places.
I had a wonderful stay, the apartment is beautiful and the views are stunning. The hosts are very welcoming and accommodating. Can't wait to go back! I fully recommend staying here.

I have spent a great stay at this flat. It is very well located, between the trendy Carouge district and the central Acacias / Plainpalais district. I found the flat in a very clean state. Even though the flat is quite small, I didn't miss anything as I could enjoy a well furnished kitchen, a great wifi, a TV and a comfortable bed. Philippe is a very careful, easy going host who well took care of my arrival. I recommend this flat for a short stay.
Nice little apartment, very clean and in good location - 1 minute walk from the tram, and lots of restaurants.

A great little studio in the heart of plainpalais. Philippe is a great host, very clear check in instructions and quick to respond to any questions (even stupid questions like I did!!) It's a small studio, but everything you need for a comfortable stay. Good equipment in the kitchen, great shower and a comfortable bed. The studio is on the ground floor and the building is very quiet. The location is great, 2 min walk to uni-mall tram stop, or 5 min walk to plainpalais for various buses and trams. I was working near the UN and journey time was 20 minutes. Would highly recommend for a short stay in Geneva.

Simple, cozy spot in excellent location. Comfortable bed., clean. Transportation and grocery right outside the door. Host very nice to deal with. Great heat and hot water and fridge and stove. Daylight basement with excellent electric lighting and barrier to traffic sound. A private, quiet get away where you can recharge for the day’s adventures.

Nice studio, you have everything you need for a short stay in Geneva. It was warm and cozy during the winter time. Check in was smooth, no issues at all. The studio is underground so be aware there is no view through the shaded windows. There was a strong smoke smell all over the place.
Cydne is a wonderful host and the place is great. I really enjoyed my stay. Highly recommend!
Home is very near to the geneve train station. Host is very good and response very quickly. you can use the kitchen and fridge. I had a nice stay in Samia s home.

Samia 's artistic oasis is located in a lively area of the city. I only took public transportation once from the airport, but later realized that Samia is a pleasant 53 minute walk from the airport. I also walked to the convention center which is near the airport each day I stayed with her. She is about 15 minutes from Old Town and within 20 minutes of everything you could want to see in Geneva. if you are an artist/creative-type, her place will inspire you! Filled with paintings that she has created, musical instruments, and colorful details. Samia is very kind and helpful. Recommended!
Great place in the perfect location for meeting at WHO. Would strongly recommend this place. Impeccably clean and comfortable
Great and unique place in Geneva. Located next to the Rhone valley, so you feel in the countryside in the middle of Geneva. Also great reception by the owner!
This is a great location. You can get everywhere on foot or with public transportation. The apartment was clean and welcoming.

Helena’s apartment is perfect for a stay in Geneva. It is right in the center of town and has everything you need (comfortable bed, clean bathroom, nice kitchen, washing machine, good closet space, perfect WiFi, etc.) I would definitely stay there again !
Ana was really kind, the apartment was just perfect and had a very beautiful view. I definitely recommend it.
Great apartment in the best location you can find in Geneva. Philipe is very friendly and I would highly recommend this stay if you are in town !

A clean apartment in a fantastic area of a Geneva. The place can use some minor improvements (lock for toilet, shower door handle to fix and others) to be properly labelled “luxury” but overall we enjoyed the stay. Its important to note that this place isn’t suitable for you if you need air conditioning or enjoy silent nights. There is a beautiful church around that ring the bell every 15 minutes (starting at 5:00 AM …) so you wont be able to open the windows for fresh air. Not recommend when the weather is super hot 🥵. Place pictures and description are very accurate. No surprise, which is a big plus on Airbnb right now. The host is very helpful and will guide you properly to enjoy the stay!
Great little apartment, close to Cornavin train station and right next to local bus/streetcar lines. Putting the TV back in the living room would help clean up the wiring 😉
Great for a quick overnight stay. The apartment is clean and Dou was super helpful with everything :)
Directions need to be updated as they do not match the actual location of the flat. Our stay was ok despite not having hot water to shower in the morning and only one towel to use.

Wonderful stay with Patrick. He was a superb host and the apartment was lovely. The location could not have been better given the proximity to the UNOG and convenience of the bus literally 100 feet from the front door. Highly recommended
Alex is a great host, very responsive and helpful! The apartment was great, clean in a great location and very good value for money!

This place has everything that you need for traveling. You don't need to bring anything because Lionel has prepared every for you. The place is clean, fully function, and hi-tech. Lionel had a quick breakfast ready for us in the fridge. The place is 2 mins walk from the tram station and just 5 mins away from Geneva station.
A very cool spot in Geneva, ideal to start biking the Via Rhona! I met several interesting folks staying in the fascinating old house, and slept very well. Great hospitality!

Lionel’s place in Geneva is fantastic! We could not believe how spacious it was and sparkling clean! It is a very short walk from the train station, the lake and all the wonderful shops and restaurants. We could not have been happier with our stay at Lionel’s place!
Not the first time I’ve stayed with Annetta it seems to get better every time I do. Wonderful host and of course happy to stay at her apartment anytime.

Very well located in the old center of Geneva. Nice and clean place where you have a large private room with double bed, and additional single bed, as well as a seperate bathroom. Kitchen and living room are shared.
Great unit. Very clean and nice. A bit of a hike up the hill from the train station. Would stay again. Recommend.

Location, location, location! We only spent one night at Annetta’s place, but absolutely loved the location. Old town Geneva is right outside your door. And the apartment is beautifully decorated. Thank you, Annetta for sharing your beautiful space.

Just one night in Geneva and Annetta’s place was perfect. Great location. Super stylish top floor flat. The room was adorable and a good size. Loved the bathroom too. Great shower and water pressure. Her whole flat is lovely. Good communication. Nice Italian restaurant super close for an enjoyable dinner. I recommend Annetta”s place if you find yourself in Geneva 😊

Lionel’s place is pretty accurate with what is shown in the listing. It was extremely clean and the location is just perfect for seeing Geneva. Very close to trains and other transport. Would visit again on my next stay.
Great location. Annetta is a very nice host and even let me store my bags for the day after checkout. 100% would stay here again!
Very conveniently located with the train station gare Cornavin and all buses

If you are a visitor to Geneva, whether a tourist or on business, its hard to imagine you could find a better apartment for your stay. The location is fantastic - in the heart of the 'old town' which is great for tourists and convenient for business visitors as well, given the business district is not far away. The apartment is spacious and well fitted out with all of the modern convinces one would hope for - wi-fi, TV and DVD player, washing machine, dish washer etc. The host left a lot of personal touches - for example umbrellas to borrow, and juice in the fridge - which was very helpful. Enjoy this lovely apartment!
I recommend Raphël's place. It is clean and very centric. The host is friendly and available.
Clean, mostly quiet, and good value for the money.

Location is good, close to Geneva Station. Room has adequate space and large door or window for sun light. My room hot good view to the street. The cleaning lady was nice and hospitable. Good for a couple of days.

We really enjoyed our stay in Geneva, the 1-room apartment is situated in a calm area, the use of the garage is super convenient. The communication and hand-over of the keys went well even though I arrived with some delay.

We loved Marc's place. It was really close to the UN and we go to our conference everyday by foot. Walking to the gate from the apartment takes about 4 minutes! The apartment has all the necessities that we need. We enjoyed eating at the outdoor dining area one fine evening and thought that if we had more time we could have enjoyed the garden area more. Thank you, Marc.
The place is amazing. 4 mins walk to Palais de Nations. Everything was good except that the toaster was dirty and rusty, and the host probably needs to replac it with a new one.
Good location and convenient for the lake and the city

Large room in a cosy apartment, where the host makes you feel really welcome. A pretty and old building in a central location. You can sometimes hear sounds from people on the street or the bin collection.

C was wonderful. She is so very nice and friendly. It was just a couple of blocks from the water. Plenty of great places to eat right around the apartment. 15 minute walk to Old Town. It was a bit of a noisy neighborhood.

Frédéric's apartment has a perfect location in the heart of Geneva's old town, close to everything. It was just a short walk from the lake and from transportation. The highlight of the apartment was the amazing view over Geneva and the lake. The apartment had beautiful furniture and design, and we enjoyed reading the wonderful coffee table books. Frédéric was very friendly and gave us great recommendations for what to see and do, and where to eat.

Geneva was was great despite the arctic conditions, the apartment in the heart of old town is cosy, clean and comfortable, had everything I required both in the flat and locally. Frederic is super helpful and responsive, providing valuable information and tips, he obviously loves his city which translates to superior hosting skills! Would definitely recommend (as long you don't mind steps/inclines)!

The location is PERFECTION. This is a lovely, sparkling clean apartment! The bathroom was very clean and the living space was so inviting and bright! Beware there are many flights of stairs to reach the apartment, but once you get there, it’s very nice for 2. It might feel like you’re living in someone else’s home with the amount of personal items in the place, BUT I must say that Frederic was so incredibly kind. He was so understanding of our needs and went to great lengths to make us comfortable!
We had a wonderful stay at Frédéric’s place. The location is perfect and the apartment is ideal, it has everything you need - including a great coffee machine. Highly recommend!

Overall apartment is good. The location is nice, as well as building and area. Host is also good, allowed us to check in earlier. The main disadvantages are: there is no elevator inside of the building and apartment is located on 4th floor. Consider this fact if you have a lot of baggage or it is difficult for you to go upstairs. Also apartment is pretty cold inside and there was no heaters, etc. We have been in Geneva few days at the end of May, and seemed like outside was warmer than inside of this apartment. Thanks
The house is super clean and very well equipped. Everything that you might need is there. The location of the house is excellent.
Fantastic location that was walkable to everything and the apartment has everything you need.

1. 不是网页上写的地址，是在那个地址附近的另外一间老公寓 2. First floor is actually the 2nd floor, there are stairs to the ground floor and another level up the stairs is the 1st floor 3. No elevator, so if you travel with luggage, this is NOT the place for you, as the stairs are high and steep and swirly 4. Contacting the host is absolutely impossible! Airbnb customer service and I tried to contact her on arrival to the listing, there was no reply until the next morning! THANK GOD bnb customer service found me a hotel to stay instead Conclusion: if you want a trouble free check in, if you want to carry luggage with you and if you want to stay at the same address as listed DON’t choose this place! As NO ONE will pick up the phone or reply to your msg even if you are troubled, as then number is just numbers

Chet's place is next to main train station and in the city centre. It is a lovely aptm with great personal touches of a free spirited artist. I loved it. Thank you Chet for your prompt communication and your overall hospitality.
Nice location. Flat was clean, tidy and modern furnished. Good value for the money. Great host. Definitely recommend.

Rabia's place is fabulous. Centrally located, safe, quiet, clean and beautiful. Rabia was super communicative and helpful, and the place is exactly like it looks in the pictures. I would definitely stay there again. Thank you, Rabia!

Lovely apartment that is super centrally located. Bus stops and train station at few minutes walk, the lake is also very close. There is a big commercial center just outside the building, very practical for shopping and food. Rouby was very accommodating and extremely flexible with my check in and out, which made my life super easy! She is very kind and bought me coffee and water for the stay, which was unexpected and lovely! The apartment is very clean and quite, I had a perfect stay!
Fabulous location and nice room Mehdi was very helpful and flexible When I decided to extend my stay in Geneva I booked the same room again

Perfectly located apartment, with everything you need to live from the very first day. The kitchen appliances, TV, washing machine... are al modern and very useful. I would recommend it to visit Geneva or to commute, as it was my case, to CERN for work.
Nice room with enough space, enjoyable for two people. Everything we needed and more with its proximity to public transportation and the mall. Will come back if given the chance.
This place is nice and easy to go by Google maps. The owner is patient and helpful.
Cracking apartment, very spacious in a cool neighbourhood. Easy walking distance to the lake and well equipped. Loved the nespresso machine. Perfect choice :-)
Misha’s place was stylish and the location was great. Amazing value for money. He was a great host and responded quickly to messages. Loved our experience!
It’s a nice place and the host is really nice.

We were very pleased with our stay. The studio was comfortable and had heating which was an advantage as the weather got suddenly cold. Check in and Check out were easy and flexible. Good communication from the host. Close to the city center and to a big park with playgrounds. Few nice cafés arounds and supermarkets close by.

This was a nice, family friendly place in a very walkable area, close to the sites of the city. Our young son very much enjoyed the play area in the house and we loved the parks, beach, and sites nearby. The one downside is the apartment is a bit loud as the building allows a lot of sound from the halls, neighbors, and street. It is not in a noisy or super busy part of the city, but you can hear as people are passing by or if the neighbors are moving around upstairs or out in the hallway. Even still, we loved everything else, were very comfortable, and enjoyed being centrally located. The hosts are super responsive and helpful. Highly recommend, and we would love to stay here again!
Olga & Boris are really friendly and responsive. The apartment is extremely clean and tidy. My friends and I spent a wonderful time here. Would love to come back again!

Great location! Can walk to lake, parks, and old town. Numerous restaurants and coffee shops in area. 2 grocery stores close by. Host greeted us at the flat and showed us how everything worked. He checked in with us numerous times. Very friendly. Bice to have a washer. Some street noise as to be expected from a city location. We had a great stay.
Great location and apartment! Its nice to find a modern space in Geneva and right next to the park.

Very good stay at Marc's place, hosts were extremely kind and welcoming! Location is excellent, next to Balexert mall that offers quite a variety of things. Tram stop was a 3' walk outside the house and all amenities were offered! Would stay there again, thank you!

Marc and Marilyn were very lovely people! When I arrived earlier than expected, Marc came back early to check us in. It was a very kind gesture. The room was large and comfortable. It was very quiet at night. Marc also offered us to use the kitchen. The location was very good. The trams are just a short 5-10mins walk away and they bring us to the city centre very quickly. I would highly recommend anyone coming to Geneva for a short stay to stay with Marc and Marilyn.
Nice studio in the heart of Geneva, ideal for a couple. It is nicely furnished and very cozy.
It was a very pleasant stay. Maria was very nice to me and she has the most lovely home. And the scene outside was fantastic.
Maria’s place was lovely. Had the best sleep I’ve had in a while. It’s real close to the airport and it’s a bargain for what you get. Perfect quick stop for a nice restful sleep. Recommend.

We had a wonderful stay at Aranzazu's place - the location is incredible, it's a beautiful apartment in a calm street and everything was great. Our hosts kindly provided some staples and advice, and communication was super easy. Would definitely stay there again!
Clean and new but very small room/bed and a little noisy during the day. The hotel will be nice when finished but was still under construction when I visited in mid-February.

Very well situated small studio in the heat of the old town of Geneva. The studio is in a very fine condition and suits your basic needs perfectly. Hélène and Damien are very attentive host. Close to shopping streets and public transport. A good starting point to explore Geneva.
Very special and cosy place. Loved the hospitality, the dogs and the campfire. Highly recommended.

This place is amazing! We’ve been there at the late December, we came at the evening and the owner met us at the bus stop it was so nice. He explained all the details to us and was really kind. Yurt was warm and clean when we came. The area is so beautiful. When I open the door at the morning dog was waiting behind and wanted to play a ball:))) it was so cute! I totally recommend this place to visit! Thank you so much!
I had a great stay at Mady's studio. The studio looks just like the pictures and is well located in the city. It is also clean and well equipped. I recommend without hesitation.
Clean and comfortable place. Very easy to reach and in a central location. A bit noisy during the night but nothing unbearable.

Mady's place was perfect for my needs, having a well-equipped kitchen, comfortable bed, reliable (although not terribly fast) internet, and good location. The place was sparkling clean when I arrived and felt very welcoming.
Mady’s place is nice, the communication is nice and fluent. The bed is very comfy. Everything went very well.

This place is in a great location to get just about anywhere in the city. We were there on a Saturday night and one of the places either in the building or adjacent to our building on the ground floor had a party or celebration that started around 10pm and was still going when we got up at 3am to get ready to catch our flight. We used earplugs, but could still feel the bass beat in the pillows we slept on. It might be a fluke or a weekend-only issue. Not sure. The apartment is great and the neighbors helped us get the key box open when we had trouble with the combo the first time. The location was great for getting to and from the train station and the bus to the airport.

Had a great stay at the spacious apartment. Extremely comfortable. And the daily cleaning as well as breakfast was a big plus. Christine is a lovely host and we were fortunate to meet her in person. We had forgotten our watch in the apartment and she went an extra mile to help us out. Can’t thank her enough!! Location perfect. Everything at walking distance and well connected to public transport. Would definitely love to come back and stay here!!

Christine was fabulous! Great and prompt communication when booking and leading up to our stay. We had a large group and needed two apartments. One was only available for 2 of our 3 nights and Christine offered options for the third night and transition to different rooms was very easy. The staff were very friendly and helpful at check in and during our stay. Great location. Walkable to many sights and great restaurants. Highly recommend!!

This place is perfectly located! 10/5 for location! We had plenty of restaurants, shopping, and even a farmers market down the hill. Short walk from the waterfront and transit - even includes transportation pass. The home is a bit older, but very spacious and clean! Our group of six adults truly enjoyed our stay here. The A/C was fantastic during the summer heat with mini-splits in each room and living/dining room. Having a washer and dryer was a blessing as well! There are balconies from many of the rooms which added to the quaint vibe the place has. The building has a very small elevator which can just fit a foldable wheelchair plus one more person. The front desk were friendly and very responsive. Would recommend staying here again!

The apartment is linked with Hotel Central so you get the amenities of having someone at the front desk for check-in and assistance, cleaning, etc. Out of all the apartments I have stayed at in Europe this was by far the most spacious. Very nice, great blackout curtains and a street back from the main area so quiet at night but close to everything and walkable. Would highly recommend.
Séverine and Albany’s air bnb was just like the pictures. it was a relaxing and cozy for a unique stay. They were very friendly and helpful and we enjoyed our stay!

I stayed at Eric's place for ten nights. Though Eric was travelling during the period but he was always available over social media and his brother looked after us very well in his absence. My stay was very comfortable and in future I would stay there again. The place is highly recommended. Thanks Eric for being great host.

The flat is vintage style and very clean. At beginning a couple of lights in the living room were not working but Philippe was nice and sorted it out immediately. Communication was smooth and very rapid
Best Airbnb in town. Brigitte is a great host and the go-to-person for everything! Made my stay very easygoing since day 1 Its like a small family!

Leo's place is very comfortable, close to the Lake, the bus station, as well as the Gare Cornavin! Perfect location, very comfortable apartment and really cool lighting! Leo is also very responsive, any question we had, he answered very quickly and was super accommodating. Definitely stay here if you are in the area! Merci Leo!!
Very central and close to the tram and supermarket! Perfect for people working at Un environment house

Very nice place, super clean, great view on the lake. Owner is very kind and we felt very welcomed and almost at home. As we live in the region, we were quite demanding to be sure to have great domestic vacation close to our beloved Leman Lake. We were not dissappointed at all.
