Anne was very kind and helpful and her family place is like a five star hotel, both in terms of warm welcome, kindness and great equipments. Thanks and see you surely again soon. Michel and Marie

My family of four had a lovely stay at Anne’s beautiful home. It’s set in a quiet and charming village outside Geneva (great base for excursions around the lake and the Alps), and the place is pristine. Beautiful and well appointed home. Anne was a very helpful and responsive host. I hope to stay here again!!

Lovely place to stay, very clean and well set up apartment, short walk to the convention centre and to town and local buses. Would highly recommend! I had friends that stayed in hotels that were much more expensive and they were very dissatisfied, so very happy to have found this gem! And Guilia is very communicative and helpful.
This is the second time I am staying at Giulia’s. I love the place- super clean, well stocked, comfortable bed, and great location.

This is a fabulous stay in Geneva... the photos are absolutely accurate, including the incredible bathroom. The breakfast is amazing, and the hospitality beyond lovely. An added bonus: this spot is 5 mins walk to the bus stop to the UN & 5 mins walk to the train into Geneva, so even more central than we thought but still peaceful. Just FYI for couples (and it may be google translation service that didn’t make it totally clear to me!) the apartment is on the first floor and not fully self contained, but this may be no bother for you and for work travel, a very lovely arrangement. The hosts really made our stay... so warm and friendly (and with excellent restaurant recommendations). Hard to find a better spot in Geneva!

An amazing gem near Geneva. Fantastic hosts and a great appartment. Public transport is very nearby, both to the Palexpo and downtown Geneva. But it is also a great walk to the city from this location, it brings you through nice towns, the United Nations, several missions and more. We had good chats, good guidance and lovely breakfast!

Michael's apartment has everything needed for a 5 day stay in Geneva. Wonderfully walkable location--close to Lake Geneva, a coffee shop with great blueberry scones, a friendly Thai restaurant and public transportation. I especially loved the nearby Jardin Botanique for a peaceful walk in the morning. As far as the apartment, it is clean and comfortable with many conveniences. In particular the kitchen had more than just the basics so you don't have to worry about buying olive oil, salt & pepper, dish detergent, etc. There were also laundry supplies available for the washing machine. In general I found the care for guests to be higher than most. He even provided power converters for plugging in my laptop! Five stars!

Michael was an exceptional host. He provided ample, quick, and kind communication. It was so hot this summer in Geneva and he went out of his way to purchase extra fans for the room which helped immensely in keeping us cool and content. The apartment had great amenities and is very close to staple cafes which was very convenient. Michael was extremely supportive and flexible during a last minute checkout decision in which dates had to be modified — we so appreciated your kindness and understanding! Highly recommend for long-term stays in Geneva.

My stay in Michael’s apartment was exactly what I needed for my first weeks in Geneva. The neighborhood is very calm and it’s 5 min walking the most beautiful park in the city by the lake. It has supermarkets close and transportation to every part of town. Michael was very kind and responsive, always ready to help with all my requests. The apartment is well equipped with everything you might need and the bed is extremely comfortable. Highly recommend for short and long stays.

Nathalie’s place was lovely. It was in a great location and the view was excellent. I travel for work and was in Geneva for only two nights. Her place was exactly what I needed for a little bit of rest before I was back on the road.

Irina’s place is absolutely lovely, beautifully organized, bright, and cozy, with a charming balcony overlooking the park. It’s also just a short walk from the station Nations, which makes it incredibly convenient. Irina herself is a wonderful hostal, kind, attentive, and genuinely caring. She made me feel completely at home. I couldn’t have asked for a better stay!

Stayed at Kevin's for a quick overnight visit to Geneva. It was great location to see the old City area and near many good restaurants. He was very helpful and accommodating. The space was clean and very comfortable. I recommend it!

Great hospitality, very kind hosts. Clean room and everything needed availible. Good communication and also received great tips in terms of what to do and the public transport. Easy to access through bus stop Chambésy-Fontaine or the train station, both within walking range (More details check Maps for stops & use the TPG map/website). Moment i arrived already suggested me something to eat etc, felt very welcome and a great first AirBnB experience. They also give good advice on what to do or where to go to in town. Great, kind people in general. Next time i go back to Geneva i know where to stay! Only minor thing is that when you arrive at night the streets are very dark, but that is ofcourse not related to the hosts.

Viviane and Philippe have been outstanding hosts! Very kind and generous, always ready to go the extra mile to help. The mansion has a lot of character and is two short stops by train to the city centre (Cornavin station). This has been by far my best experience with Airbnb and, on my next trip to Geneva, I will definitely come back to this awesome place!

Conveniently located right at the side of Leman lake this listing is a pretty and comfortable place for couple. The surroundings are very walkable, beautiful view of the Leman lake. Great communication with Jeremy.

The host was very friendly and responsive. The house was superb clean and nice. The house is located in almost centre and the walk to the bus stop or tram stop is just 2/3 minutes. The station is just 10 mins away. Great location. The house is located near the restaurants and shops. Overall, had a great time. Loved it.

Bea is a great host, very helpful and understanding. During this pandemic, she really helped us to keep our reservation. The place is very clean and satisfying location is great. If you visiting Geneve, this is te place you should stay.
It was just how Marc advertised the space and a great convenient place to stay.

Pretty standard Geneva appt but very sparsely furnished, no curtains across window. Good location generally but trams run directly under the window, from early to late. Ok if you used to living in a busy area, but maybe not if you disturb easily. Finding it and gaining entry all very easy with good communication

Our host's apartment at Geneva was superb. Her arrangements in the appartment is amazing. She take care of every minute things which we need at our stay. Its another home away from our home. The location is good, you can go anywhere from this location. The tram station is just in front of the building campus and the tram service is T14 and T18. 15 minutes to Geneva Switzerland international airport.

Cute clean place. Steps away from public transportation. Too small for 3 adults though it says 4 adults. Beds were very uncomfortable. The bathroom shower system was extremely hard to figure out and it was hard to get the right temperature. The cooking space is too small . Since we stayed only for 3 nights and did not cook much were able to manage. If you are a couple and looking for a modern place and easy transportation and not into much cooking, perfect place for sure.

This is a nice studio, with a very pleasant view into a courtyard with lots of natural light. The small kitchen has a fridge (with a freezer), a Nesspresso coffee machine, a hot plate, a microwave and a toaster. The location is really nice, across the street from the President hotel, and a few feet from the lake. There are many shops, restaurants, bars, grocery stores and all sorts of services close by. There is a bus stop that takes you to the Cornavin train station.

Eniola's apartment is gorgeous. It is super clean and stylish. The location is quiet but close to tons of good bars and restaurants, and most importantly, the lake! I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again.
Lovely spot and incredibly helpful host. A bit noisy at night but as expected in the middle of the city. Highly recommend

Great place in a great location! Very clean and check-in was a breeze! There was a bit of noise several nights quite late; not sure if this was from a bar downstairs or other apartments in the building. Just something to be aware of if you're a very light sleeper....
Clean flat close to all amenities such as shops, restaurants, bars and train/trams. Comfortable beds and very clean place. The plus side is the terrace.
very clean and easy for the check in and check out.

My boyfriend and I stayed at Jeanette’s place for two nights while in Geneva. Her place is a close walk to the train station, downtown Geneva and the lake. Her and her family were great hosts and the place was clean and inviting. We had a great stay and would recommend!

First, it´s not easy to find a good and affordable place in Geneva! Thats why I was super happy with Michel´s apartment. The check-in was super easy as well as the communication with Michel. The apartment is modern, cozy and very clean. The kitchen is very well equipped and also super clean. There was even some food available, which made my stay easier! Since I stayed there for almost 3 weeks, I was happy about the washing machine in the bathroom. Furthermore, there is a bus station right nearby to get to the city center. I will come back (:

Karim’s place was excellent: very fairly priced in an excellent area, it is a perfect stepping stone to visit the lake, town and surrounding area. It was very close to public transport and a supermarket too which was very handy! Karim was an great host who responded to any queries quickly. Recommended!
Good experience in general central flat. The host very kind and help us with any doubt. recommended.

Karim is an excellent host - he was responsive, helpful, friendly and gave us local recommendations. Check-in instructions were clear, we knew exactly where to go. The apartment was clean, tidy and the beds were very comfortable. It is in an excellent location surrounded by loads of bars, cafes and restaurants, and not too far away from the train station. There is a little supermarket nearby too. Would definitely stay here again if I returned to Geneva. Thank you very much!
Clean and easy to get to from the airport. I highly recommend this apartment.

Daryl's home was clean, with all needed amenities and easy to access. I appreciated having privacy and extra-comfort during a hot summer's day thanks to the fan in the room. I recommend Daryl's home without hesitation.
Absolutely recommend staying here! The apartment was spotless, spacious, and close to anything you would need.

Very much enjoyed our stay. Marie was very accommodating and a very good host. Distance from central Geneva was not too far - very walkable or very quick on the bus. Lovely apartment and space to relax with friends.

Extremely good value for a well located apartment in Geneva. About a 11 min walk from tram, or maybe 2 min by bus. It fit our party of five alright. Furnishings were “reasonably solid” rather than “luxurious” but for the price point it can’t be beat. Worked out great for our needs and I would stay here again.
Isaac was a great host. The place was easy to find and is located right in the town centre. He was proactive in finding solutions whenever I had any requests, which really added to my comfort.

Lovely flat, actually nicer in real life than in the pictures! Lots of space in the flat, and a lovely place to relax in. Area was great, some nice cafes serving coffees/breakfast in very close proximity. Very walkable to city centre.

Very comfortable and clean. The apartment looks out on a park, so there is no external noise. Very convenient for UN, WHO and Congress Center of Geneva. Supermarket nearby. Bus stop outside the building for Line 5 that goes directly to the airport.

I had a very pleasant stay at Ruby's place, the room is very clean and the bed is confortable. Access to the kitchen is great and Ruby is a lovely host. The location is well connected with local transportation. I highly recommend this place!

Booked for family during their visit. Diane was very helpful and understanding, good communication. My family were happy when staying there , they cooked and really enjoyed the terrace. The area is peaceful , 10 mins walk to the station. Recommend if you are visiting Geneva!

I had a great two-week stay at Nice’s place. The apartment was immaculate, the room cozy, the bed comfortable, and the complimentary tea/coffee much appreciated. Nice and her husband were very friendly and easygoing, and their dog Boss was adorable. The location of the apartment is very convenient, 1 min walk from the tram. Highly recommend to any short- or long-term visitors.

Marc place was in a nice building and a nice neighborhood ,it was a bit far from the city center and the place was a bit small but good enough for couple of days! He responded fast and was there if we needed anything.
Claudio was very responsive and friendly and the place was clean, spacious, and with everything I could need.

The flat was lovely and had everything we needed, including a hairdryer. It also had a fan that was more than enough, despite the 30oC. The house was very clean and very close to the city centre, the train station and the lake.

Emmile is a great host and I strongly recommend to other. He is friendly and helpful in giving advices on local travel and shopping for Swiss watch in particular. He liked cooking and may invite guest for a taste. The coffee he offered was also good supplementary for refreshing morning.

It was ok overall, the door was a bit hard to open - basically when I try to open the door, the key just kept spinning with click sound. Eventually I opened it but not sure how it actually happened, I just kept on trying 😅 The room and bathroom was a bit dirty, especially the sofa and table in the room and bathroom (towels and other stuff was everywhere). The room was spacious, it is worth it cuz it’s really cheap compare to other hotels or anything. But I would’ve booked different Airbnb or hotel room if I knew how the bathroom looks like earlier on. It was good overall though! :D
This wasn't a great experience. Roommate hoarded the kitchen with dirty dishes. No keys for bathroom and toilett. Location is very good though.

The flat is in a stylish modern block just around the corner from the regional headquarters for UBS and has good transport links into the center. The secure car parking was important to me on this trip, so an excellent choice for my son, my sister and I.
Philippe got us all the important information and he called to ensure we knew how to check in. Great experience.

Great location, beautiful and very tasteful decorated apartment in the heart of Pâquis. The owners are very helpful and available. It’s a real jewel I can only recommend, I had a wonderful time there.
Anna's place is stylish and beautiful. The room is in a basement that provides just the right amount of privacy to rest from international-long travels.

The apartment was very conveniently located; on the 14 and 18 tram lines with direct access to Gare Cornavin, CERN, Bel-Air, Meyrin, etc., and 10 bus for easy transport to/from the airport. It's a short walk to a mall with a large Migros and many convenient shops, food options with late hours, etc. There is also a convenient pizza shop adjacent to the building with reasonable prices and hours. Bekim was a great host, who was very easy to work with. I was there with my family for the summer, and he went above and beyond in stocking the apartment with everything we needed (coffee pods, laundry and dishwashing detergent, soap, etc.), and even helped transport us and our luggage from the airport.

David’s place was perfect for us. As a couple we really enjoyed the artsy and stylish big spaces in the apartment. We recommend it a lot for people whose have a taste. Furthermore it is really central and very few mins walking distance to the main shopping street and to the Jet. We are very happy with our stay and David was very responsible. Definitely would love to return next time. Thank you David again 😊
This is a very nice studio apartment in an excellent location in Geneva, very close to the lake, shopping and the Cornavin station. Manuel is very nice and helpful.

Highly recommend staying with Flora. She is such a lovely person and a great host. The apartment is rather small but cozy and artsy and has everything you need. It’s located very central, close to the lake and in walking distance to the center of Geneva. Flora provided lots of tips for bars and restaurants and even left me the keys to her bike! Would always stay here again.
Sonia is a great host, very kind and helpful. The apartment is clean, decent location. I strongly recommend!
Lovely home and very nice host! Great position in the city, best for travelling around Geneva.

Frank´s apartment is fantastic! The apartment is really new, modern and clean. 2 big bedrooms and spacious and confortable living room. It will located in a quiet residential area but really well located, direct tram line to the city center (10min by tram) and close to airport (15min). Frank was a great host, he gave us few key tips and suggestions and he kindly offered us to make late check out and his carbox. I highly recommend Frank´s apartment.

Extremely happy in staying at Amy's. The place matched the pics 100%, she was super friendly and adaptable for checking-in - even in my almost-last-minute booking. The bed was really comfortable for a perfect night of sleep, and the area is full of nice bars and restaurants around. It was my 3rd time in Geneva, but 1st in that area and I am super happy with it. Would definitely stay again.

The place is comfortable and location is perfect, easy to go around exploring Geneve. Karim is very responsive from the booking till we check out. He even allow us to store our luggage after we check out so we can explore the city a bit longer. Highly recommended!

Apartment in a great location and Karim was a helpful and responsive host. Simple things could have really improved our stay such as updating the bed linens, towels, shower curtain, etc. they were not in the best condition. The sofa bed is not suitable for anyone to sleep in and we were unable to use it during our stay, which is unfortunate as it was the main reason we booked this place.
Nice people and very welcoming. Enjoyed the stay.
Although my friend and I arrived in Geneva very late, this did not delay the landlord from receiving us. The house is clean and tidy, Complete kitchen utensils

We had a really lovely stay at Karim’s place. He was so accommodating of our needs - even providing an adaptor at 10pm when he realised that the ones in the apartment were missing. He was super responsive and couldn’t have done more for us! We stayed with our five month old son and the apartment was quiet enough for him to sleep (although we stayed during the week - so may be different on the weekend). Karim provided a cot and everything we needed. Great location too - with good bars and restaurants nearby but not too busy. Would really recommend.

Karim’s place was located in a very convenient location, within walking distance to the restaurant I booked and a short ride from Geneva airport / train station. Place was very clean, check in was fuss free and the building was very secure.

Nelson was accommodating, he let me deposit my bags early before checking in. The area is nice and very close to bus station. It might get a bit noisy at night as there are restaurants and pubs downstairs

Clean, spacious and bright apartment in a great location. Gabriela was an amazing host. I met her in person for check-in and she provided me with all the necessary info. The apartment is very well equipped in a quiet neighborhood with a ton of natural light. Thank you Gabriela! I hope we meet again.

The apartment is located in a quiet place near the airport and very close to the bus station. The apartment is spacious and sunny. The kitchen is fully equipped so you feel at home! Gabriela always responded immediately to any questions I had. I will definitely visit Gabriela's apartment again!

The Apartment is very clean,new and well equipped, even with a mini-‘Cafe’. It is centrally located within walking distance to most amenities and tourist attractions like the flower clock, and Water Jet. Near to Supermarkets and restaurants. Free Parking nearby from 5pm-8am. Other hours are chargeable at a reasonable rate. Oscar is a great host and very responsive even in the late evening hours. Highly recommended 👍

Anthony has been a great host. Very hospitable and accomodating. Communication was great. The place was in tip top shape. Sparkling clean bathroom. Very close to the airport and with easy links to the city centre. Would highly recommend.

Anthony is a great host, very helpful and friendly. His apartment is exactly as described, very clean and nice. Location is good for getting to/from the airport. Highly recommended, If I’m back in Geneve again- his apartment will be my choice of stay!

Samia was very welcoming and considerate. The apartment is in a great location. It's very easy to walk to the city center and to the train station. I'd be happy to stay again if I return to Geneva! Thank you for everything, Samia :)

I had an excellent six-week stay at Jon and his family's beautiful home thanks to the warm welcome and kind hospitality. They set the bar really high in terms of making their guests feel at home, making sure the breakfast is according to one's wishes and fresh towels etc. are always available. The house is super clean and the room newly furnished. The neighbourhood is very calm and beautiful, with parks nearby and a stunning view of the mountains. I can truly recommend to stay there and wish them all the best !
Nice and clean place, well located, easy access by transport. Very good communication with the host.
Wonderful place, very convenient location of the apartment! Thank so much for Lionel very much for your hospitality and a wonderful apartment!

The bed and sheets smelled a lot like tabaco. Even though I left the window open from when I received de Airbnb til night, the smell kept in the room. Pillows as well were non usable because of the smell. Is very well located tho. Also pretty spacious.

Great stay at Sergio, he’s such a nice person, all the time smiling and all the time there to help you if you need anything. The room was very big, clean and the bed really comfortable. You can go to Geneve by taking the bus in front of the house. Small private beach close to the house.

I felt very welcome and as if I was visiting my friends or family. The location is very convenient (I was going to the congress centre) and the bed is so comfortable that it is sad to go out of it in the morning.

Tarek is a great host, open minded and easy going person. Attentive to guest accommodation and helped me with local interaction and communication. The place is spacious, bright and clean and has everything i needed in terms of comfort and facilities. The location is perfect for my study and public transport connection. The neighborhood is quite and calm with private territory which is also a great bonus. I’d definitely recommend Tarek and his apartment for stay and just to have a good person in Geneva. I’ll stay here next time for sure! Besides good accommodation i now have a nice and kind person to stay in touch with! Thank you so much. You made my stay in Geneva better than i could expect.
Nice 1 room apartment for a 2 adults. Sunny Terrace and located at walking distance of Park , Lake , City Center and - last but not least - of the Railway station Eaux Vives.

We had a good stay at Maki & Tedi’s place. They and their house was welcoming and cosy. We were picked up by car by Maki at check-in as it was raining; thanks for that and for the local tips. The place was clean and in good condition, we had privacy as well; much appreciated. Regards, Iulian & Amelia

IIinca’s place was perfect for a quick stay in Geneva. Check in was seamless and the room is spacious and had an incredible view of the city. IIinca was also very friendly and kind. Would definitely stay here again and recommend it for future travelers. Thanks!
Although it was a very short stay, but Anne-Lise was very welcoming and explained everything clearly. The place was spacious, quiet, and comfortable. Everything I neeed was there from the get-go.

I stayed in Magali's studio for a week and can warmly recommend it. The studio is exactly as described - clean, in an excellent location, with a good view of the lake; communication with Magali was very easy. I will look forward to returning next time I am in Geneva.

Ilinca's place was very close to everything. She is very kind and helpful with anything you may need. I had to work for 2 nights while there and the wifi was strong enough for video calls. There was no fan available, and Geneva in July is very hot so it was difficult to sleep even with the window open if you are not used to the heat. Also, the bed is quite firm for me, but if you like firm mattresses then this would be a good pick.

Excellent location. Old building but in the apartment very clean and all functioned. Usage of fridge and microwave is helpful. Mother of Bianca is super helpful and can assist with anything one might need. I was able to prolong my stay for an hour because of meeting. Really recommend. Would definitely come again. Bostjan
Near to the tram station, clean, and comfortable bed

A great flat to stay in to explore the city, the neighbourhood felt very quiet and safe and ideal with our young son with us. There is a great park for little ones nearby which we loved, and very easy to use buses into the city. The flat was very spacious and clean. Easy to get to from the airport or main train station, Philippe sent us clear instructions which were really useful. I would definitely recommend to stay here.
Very nice and helpful host. The place itself had everything we needed and is located very close to the train station. Would definitely stay again!

Myself and my my family were very happy with the staying . Very relaxed and family oriented, peaceful flat. Clean and with many utensils. Emmanuelle is very friendly and quick responsive person. Would definitely stay in next time and recommended to stay.

Nice location, 15 minutes walk from the lake. The flat was clean when we arrived. It has a well-equipped kitchen and a small bathroom. In the living room there is a table and 2 sofa beds which can be a bit uncomfortable if you stay for a long period. David is very helpful and responds in a short time.

Would be great if all airbnb hosts could be as good as Lisa. So much thought and generosity has gone into making her place as convenient and enjoyable place to stay as possible, add to that the beautiful surroundings, the proximity of the lake and the 4 trains an hour to central Geneva (10 mins away), it made for a very enjoyable couple of weeks. Strong recommend.

The host needs to communicate well with people either I’m talking to a robot or aggressive person, The apartment has one advantage it’s in the middle of the city other than that nothing The kitchen was mess we started to clean the microwave there was hair and food stains
Really nice hotel, safe and close to the train station
Clean and comfortable. Simple room very close to the train station. Not all guest rooms have updated bathrooms.

Being next to the station and near to the old town and the lake, the location was excellent. Valentino was helpful with directions to places. The check in went smoothly. Our room was up at the top of the hotel ( with a lift) and we liked it .

We were rather disappointed in our stay. There is no toilet paper, and we did not feel particularly welcome, and the other parts of the apartment it was a pretty rough neighborhood, and though she was very sweet it didn’t make up for the lack of normal amenities.
Great location, close to train station. The flat is clean and spacious. Only a little bit noisy in the morning from the street, otherwise all good.
Great place, and great location. My favorite part was the portable wifi!
Super accurate and great listing! In the perfect spot to walk to just about anything. We had no issues at all and enjoyed our time.

This is the first 5 star review I have ever given. Gourmet grocery in the Dept store basement across the street! We would have gotten all of our meals and supplies there from day 1 if we had discovered this hidden gem. Transit Hub out the front door. you can get to anywhere in Geneve from there. Get your pass online or from the vending machine. Transport bus #5 or #10 from the airport or Cornavin station. Very clean cute Studio. Bed was very comfortable. Kitchen small portablewas great! great! Next time in Geneve we will rent again. Lovely city and Apt.
Amazing apartment in the heart of Geneva. It is within walking distance to the lake and old town. We had a great stay and would love to come back another time.
Raphaël was a great host and provided extremely helpful instructions and assistance. The apartment was perfect for my quick trip, and I had a very enjoyable stay.
Amazing location right next to train station. In an older building. The unit had everything we needed and looked like the photos! Thank you for hosting us!
This was my third time staying at Jonathan's parents (for a reason). Absolutely loved it and would recommend it to everybody! The best air bnb I have seen so far. Thank you for everything!

Elise's place has its beautiful charm, full of collections and interesting hobbies. My private room was spacious and clean, and I was welcomed with a tasty Toblerone. I felt comfortable at all times, my main idea was to leave early to the train station but I deeply enjoyed the bed and the cozyness of the place. Thanks a lot Elise for accepting my last minute request!
wonderful memory Feel the kindness and hospitality Hope to come here for the second time 房东特别好！！我航班早到了，提前了五小时入住都可以！！中国女孩们快来体验，入股不亏！！

Proximity to station is great if you are meeting people from trains or flights and perfect for a quick departure. Ideal for short breaks. Useful shops in station complex and short walk to the beautiful lake. Open all hours reception and welcoming foyer. The room and shower room are comfortable. We slept well, loved the fridge for keeping milk cool and the kettle for boiling water for a cuppa. Would book again.

Lou,s room was clean, bright and comfortable. The location is fantastic... 3blocks from the lake and a 5 minute walk to the train station. Lou was very helpful with directions and places to see. Her dog, Lea is sweet and quiet. I would definitely recommend Lou s place.

Lou and Lea were very warm and welcoming. Lou is friendly, kind and helpful. The place is at a perfect location from the city centre, train station, Lake Geneva. The place is clean and hygienic. Definitely a must go and stay !

This place is a hidden gem. It’s very centrally located, easily accessible to the old town with either bus/train or even walking which we did. There is a train station a few yards away which is extremely convenient. Whilst the place is a studio, it has everything you would need and two of us were able to stay comfortably. Very high cleanliness levels also, and Yu’s communication is also great. She was very helpful and responded promptly. If I were to come back I would definitely book this place again.
Diana is very nice and she always had quick response. Unluckily, there is a heat wave in Geneva so it’s very hot, we got the fan fm Diana, no problem at all.
Nice place, close to the village Centre. Interesting configuration with the ultra modern shared lounge area and adjacent studios.

Manuel's home was a ideal choice of accommodation while exploring Geneva. The location was superb. It was quiet, convenient, had cafes, restaurants, shops, train station, lake, all within a very short distance. Manuel's home is perfect for a solo or couple looking to explore Geneva area. It had so many facilities inside the apartment to cook and prepare for yourself. I had the most amazing time, just wish it was longer. I would definitely stay here again, without any doubt.

The area was very beautiful. The place was very clean and the bed very comfortable! It is very close to transportation. Marc was very helpful and responsive. My favorite part of the place, although there were many things I liked, were the big windows. It had a very pleasant view.

Excellent and generously sized room in a hotel, suitable for quarantine in today’s Covid-19 times upon arrival from another country - incredibly friendly and helpful staff, amazing cleaners, fantastic location. Kitchen well equipped with all the essentials and front desk very helpful for deliveries from the outside world. Highly recommended.

Central, no frills accomodation close to plenty of restaurants and bars. The Internet comes from a 3G phone and I managed to connect with a bit of help from a lovely host. Everything is as described and I enjoyed my short stay.

We had a lovely time at Kayla's. During the short time we stayed, Kayla gave us some helpful hints on where to go and what to see. Her flat is in a good location, 10 minutes away from the Airport and 20 from the city centre.
Nice stay at Kayla's place, she is very friendly and nice and has a positive aura. The room was large and bright with a comfortable bed.
Great host, lovely place and really appreciated Yann’s flexibility with check in and check out. And thanks for the wine Yann! Would definitely recommend 😊
We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described,clean, cozy, and very comfortable. Communication with the host was smooth and easy. Highly recommended!

The airbnb was generally clean, but some better preparation would've greatly improved our stay. We had to purchase washing machine detergent and cleaning brush for the dishes, as well as the shampoo looked to be left from previous visitors, these didn't provide a welcoming feeling. Also, even though our reservation was for 3 people, there was only 2 towels provided which also could be improved with better preparation.It was quite hot inside where it was hard to sleep the first night, the posting does mention there's no AC, but thought I'd mention this for the sake of others who can't sleep in hot places.
This is a fantastic, modern studio in Carouges. It makes access to the city very easy and flexible. I love staying here when I am in Geneva.

If you are lucky enough to find this lovely little studio available take it! The place can't be better located for an immersion to picturesque Carouge. Tram pass just at the door of the place but you hear absolutely nothing inside. Check-in and check-out was smooth and Mat very responsive. He is very flexible and kind and even encourage me to take some cherries from the Tree in the courtyard. In a nutshell, great value for money and the perfect place for a great travel experience.

I had a great weekend here at Valeries place. The location is very good for the price. It is only a 10 minute walk to the old town and lakes edge. The apartment was larger than I expected, there was lots of room. The bed was comfortable and the the kitchen was pleasant. The value for Valeries place is really good, especially for an expensive city like Geneva.

Tous 5*Alles 5*Tutto 5*per me Todo 5* para mi All I value with 5* I was lucky to stay in this home, where I felt at home. Thank you very much, so God will revisit again. Geneva population mix has changed lot. Near station I tasted Läderach Chocolate, the founder is/was a great person with values which made Singapur the best country, Republic of Geneva should adapt and be the best country!
Eva is a charming Lady, very attentive and helpful. the flat is super close to the translation, which is is super convenient.
Leandro is a great host! The place was very clean, the check-in was very easy, and the location is great. I will definitely be staying here again.

Léo is a great host, very laid back and flexible. He met me at check-in and made sure that I had all the info I needed. The room is quiet, clean, and well-situated. Bathroom and kitchen are shared and clean with a cleaning service passing regularly. No lock on the bedroom door, but I never felt at risk. Excellent value and convenience.

Although we couldn't speak the same language, we were able to communicate, and Eva was super nice and friendly, and I felt welcomed and glad to have a quiet little haven in her home. There was plenty of room for my stuff in the room, as well as a writing desk. The bed was very comfortable, and I slept very well! I would especially recommend Eva's place to someone who is quiet and doesn't need constant stimulation. The location is near public transportation. Thank you, Eva! :)

Daniel’s place is exactly as described, spotlessly clean and very comfortable. It’s in a great location with a fab roof terrace. Daniel was very helpful and kind. Would thoroughly recommend the apartment!

Fantastic rental and super kid friendly. My family stayed here with my 3 year old and infant baby. The beds were super comfortable and the apartment had everything we needed to cook. I loved that there was a high chair and baby cot. It’s in a very convenient location close to the train and bus stations and to the lake and other tourist destinations. Also many restaurants closeby. I would absolutely stay here again!
Daniel was wonderful and the place was perfect and conveniently located
Lovely place to be with the kids while working at the UN - park across the road and easily accessible for transport

I stayed in Tommy’s flat for a month while working in Geneva. Wonderful and cozy flat with a lot of plants, nice books and balcony for the morning coffee :-) Also fully equipped and clean. Tommy is a super host - very communicative and flexible. Loved the area as well, loads of nice restaurants and cafes, close to the river + everything I needed within walking distance. Thanks a lot for the stay! Highly recommendable :-)
Pauline was a wonderful host! her place is perfectly located for a conference or to pop into the old town. the space is cosy and homey and she is very communicative. All in all a great stay!
This is a beautiful apartment, fitted with all the amenities. The host was prompt in his communication and so helpful with all queries. Great location!

Our stay with host was absolutely wonderful! They were incredibly warm and welcoming from the moment we arrived, making us feel right at home. Their adorable cat was such a sweet bonus—so friendly and playful, it really added to the cozy vibe of the place

It was super nice to stay at Brice's for a few days in Geneva. His appartment has everything you need and is in walking distance to almost everything in the city. And the balcony is perfect for having breakfast in the sun.

Comfy stay, good location next to Lake Geneva (close to the water ferries), in a nice neighbourhood and not far from the central train station. Friendly and helpful staff as well. Fresh tasty, buffet breakfast. Would recommend bringing small extension lead due to number of plug sockets in the room. Certainly worth booking though! 😊
We stayed one night. Was an easy walk to the lake and we were able to check in early.

I was really appreciative of how helpful and available Samuel was, including meeting us where we had gotten lost to help us get in, giving a tour of the house on check in, and explaining how to use the airport transit. That felt like above and beyond hospitality, in addition to being a really great place/view.

Beautiful apartment, with everything you could need. Rachel was very kind and responsive, and gave great local recommendations. Neighbourhood had plenty of stores and resraurants nearby, and the apartment was right next to a tram stop for easy access everywhere, though walking was no isse either, with about 30 min walk to the lake.

My sister and I spent 10 amazing days in Rachel's flat. She was from the beginning, very kind and attentive. She was easy to reach whenever we had a question and always gave clear instructions and also gave good recommendations of where to go or to eat. She made the check in and the rest of the stay feel very straightforward. The property was exactly as described. Clean, comfy and well equipped. Easy to access and close to everything we needed, supermarkets, shops, bakery, restaurants...also we look after her cat Tilly who is the cutest cat we ever met. We really recommend 100% Rachel's flat and if at some point we go back to Geneva, we will definitely choose Rachel's home. <3 - Muchas gracias por todo!

Spacious and fully equipped apartment a few minutes from Geneva. I needed convenient spot to visit the nearby clinic, this was a great selection. Offers parking, a rare thing, view of the mountains and a beautiful farmers market on Saturdays.
All went very smooth, despite booking just the night before. The room is beautiful and spacious (there are 3 bed, 1 doubel and 2 sinlge). It is a very quiet place despite being close to the center.
Thanks Gem. I enjoyed the stay - the property was clean and bright and well equipped and suited my needs perfectly. The TV is amazing and wifi was excellent. Gerry
Bianca’s place is amazing! The apartment was incredibly central, clean, and comfy! Would highly highly recommend this to anyone traveling to Geneva

Bianca's place was conveniently located right next to the main train station. The apartment was spacious and the kitchen was functional. The check-in and check-out process went smoothly and Bianca doesn't require any additional help when leaving (for example taking out the trash of doing the dishes). A very clean and fun experience!
Everything was good! Little trouble checking in and getting that sorted out, but once it was figured out, everything was fine! In a good location, and the apartment was nice.
Always great stay by Phillip, love the location, the apartment and everything! Phillip is always great and polite and helpful! Highly recommend it! Cheers Pedro
A wonderful place, just a few minutes walk to the lake. The apartment was clean and just as described.

Best place ever. I had all what I needed. Nathalie help me with all my doubts and concern with my itinerary. The house is clean and ordered and quiet to sleep what I didn't days before. 200% recommended

Alex is a super friendly and nice host and in his appartement, everything is neatly placed. All the information of the appartement, including the self-checkin, the code , the address was listed clearly before my arrival. Alex had provided me with great suggestions about the city and life here in Geneva. I highly recommend the appartement since it’s close to the train station and not far from the airport, really convenient for one just arrived. Especially a cosy and safe place for ladies traveling alone or students.

I had an amazing stay with Ludovica. It truly felt like visiting a family member. She's an amazing host and a kind and caring person. She's has a great sense of humor and is great to have a chat with! She also has great local recommendations, so don't miss the chance to ask her about stuff to do in and around Geneva. The room is as described, comfortable bed, clean room and bed linen, and quiet - perfect for a single traveler. You also have full access to the kitchen. The location is great, close to public transport should you need it and 15 minute walk away from the old center. Thank you Ludovica for the dinners and lovely chats! I hope to see you again. Definitely recommended 👍❤️

I had a wonderful time at Ludovica‘s place. The room is tidy, spaneous, and comfortable and in general i immediately felt like home. Ludovica is super a nice host! I can warmly recommend this place :)

Well-furnished and comfortable flat with beams showing in a lovely old house. Walking distance of ICRC and Palaus de Nations, across from the Jardin des Penthes. Yet it feels like staying in a bucolic village. Ntombifuthi is nice, flexible and responsive. Regrettably I couldn’t meet her in person. Definitively good value for money, especially for Geneva! Very much recommended.
Host was very accommodating and welcoming! The flat is well taken care of, they even had a tea pot and extra blankets which I personally loved when it was raining!! Was close to public transit!

This was our second stay at Arthur and Camille's place. The hosts are very friendly and good communicators. They accommodated our request for an early check-in and extra bedding for my daughter. The place is amazing- the best you can find in Geneva - its location, style, and cleanliness are superb. We really enjoyed our stay and will definitely come back next time.
The place was clean and exactly like pictured. Close to the bus stop so easy to get around. There's also a Coop right by, so very convenient.
Nice location which was very walkable to the rest of Geneva. Friendly and responsive host.
Julieta is a great home. Gave clear description to the accommodation and was willing to support, where required. The apartment was quite clean and worth the pay

We really enjoyed our stay here. The place is conveniently located, around 10mins away from old town. The flat itself is large we could comfortably stay with the family. The host is responsive and quickly answered all our questions. Highly recommend!
I had a truly wonderful stay, the apartment is cosy, Lucia is welcoming and easy going, the area both central and calm. Will come back !

I staid three nights with Lucia for a wo k trip to Geneva and had a really good time. Lucia is really easy to communicate with and very welcoming. The flat is great and you feel like at home. I would highly recommend it!
Very lovely stay near the lake with easy transport everywhere. It was safe, clean, and spacious. I had everything I needed and felt welcomed.

The apartment was exactly as advertised and perfect for our needs. We were out and about all day only returning in the evening and the location was very good for us. Very easy transfer to the airport with a tram at the top of the road to the train station and the train directly to the airport. Took around 35 mins and cost €3 each. Answers to queries were very quick. Happy to recommend!

Cristina’s place was wonderful. It was walkable to everything and the check in was very easy. The bed was cozy. There is some noise since it’s in such a central location, but nothing more than what you would expect from a city street. We would definitely come back.
We were very pleased with the accommodation. Excellent location and super friendly and commutative host. Thank you!

I have stayed here many times. each time there is something new. I love it. and the water pressure in the shower is the best in Geneva. right next to the 18 and 14 trams and walking from the train station, makes the location ideal. and Sofia is an amazing host. always responsive and always helpful. will probably be staying at this place as long as she has it listed and I can travel here.
Cristina’s place is a beautiful apartment to stay in Geneva. Very well connected to the city centre and other attractions. Cristina gave amazing recommendations and was always very responsive.
Great location, very walkable with easy access to transit. Nice to stay have a kitchen and fridge, and the air conditioner was great, as it was unusually warm in Geneva.

Comfortable space and decently convenient to the airport which was important to us. Very thankful for the portable AC unit provided as it was very hot in Geneva while we were there. The biggest con is that we had to get our heavy luggage up two flights of stairs, but overall a pleasant stay!
Great place to stay in Geneva. Close to tram links, supermarket and walkable to the old town. Very comfy, big bed! Cristina gave us some great local recommendations, too.

Marvelous experience with this airbnb. Imen and her daughter Shrin are great hosts!!! Feeling home away from home-this what it literally is. Very convenient location few blocks from Carnivor train station whiich takes you in 7 minutes to the airport. Walking distance to all UN agencies which was very convenient for me. Room is big and spacious, next to it there is a bathroom which host generously gives to your disposal, so you have your own bathroom with shower tab next to the room. Sipping coffee in the evening, granola bar and sweets shared in the morning, those are small , but generous touch of great host Imen. Thank you for all, highly recommended place.

Antonio is truly a gem of a host! From the moment we arrived, he made us feel completely at home. The room was spotless, with tasteful interiors and a super comfortable mattress – exactly what we needed after long days out exploring. My wife and I stayed for 4 nights and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The location is fantastic – just a short walk to Geneva Lake, surrounded by great eateries, and the Rue du Lac bus stop is right around the corner, which made getting around really easy. Highly recommend staying here if you're visiting Geneva. Thanks again, Antonio! Going back home with a friend in Geneva.

Always a pleasure to stop on such an iconic fantastic Geneva Avenue. You can walk anywhere from here and feel that cosmopolitan Geneva stroll you love, whether towards the Lake Veille Ville or to the trains beyond!
Karim was responsive and accomodating. Was nice that we could drop our bags before the official check in timing. Location is amazing - train station 5 min away, Manor mall 4 min walk away, etc.

lovely spacious studio, also ideal for longer stays, situated in a beautiful building. the coffee was very good. we could occupy very short notice, which was a blessing. karim is friendly and check-in is flexible. quite a few basic things in the flat need fixing and the dusty layer on the floor and surfaces disturbed us. this could be due to renovations to the building itself.

Excellent location, bang in the centre with food, massive supermarket, and the central station just a few minutes walk away. The check in process was extremely stress free and the place as described. Communication was quick and accurate, including my ridiculous request for information about the amazing mattress! There were a few nice surprises not mentioned on the listing too. Great place and very happy to stay again. Thanks again.
i was honestly worried at first since there were not any reviews but I had a great stay here. the location is convenient and cheap compared to anywhere else.

Veronica is a phenomenal host! Very responsive, caring and helpful! The apartment is located in one of the most prestigious neighborhoods of Geneva and is cosy and fully equipped! I highly recommend it!
Isabelle's and Bianca's place is very nice and matches the description very well - I only stayed for one night but it was very pleasant. Communication was great too!

isabelle's place is very good as a work accomodation in Geneva. living in one of the rooms of the house offers the privacy and conviniences. neighborehood has easy access to supermarkets. walking to the UN area takes 35-40 minutes. roomates in general are quiet and considerate. I would recommend Isabelle's place to other people who have to work in Geneva.

Perfect stay in a great location in Eaux-Vives with restaurants and supermarkets all around. The nearest bus stop is a 2 min walk away. Barely 5 mins from the Jet/lake. The room was super clean and very beautifully designed and decorated. I would love to return and stay here for my next trip. The kitchen has all the amenities needed and the bathroom was very clean. Lots of cupboards and wardrobe space too which I always prefer. Thank you Paul for communicating efficiently. I visit Geneva often and this is one of the best places I’ve stayed at.

Serge was extremely patient, kind, and helpful. His location is very close to the airport and the bed was very comfortable. We had everything we needed to unwind, refresh, and get going in the morning.
Overall it was a very good experience. Worth the price! Location very close to the airport. Serge was kind, flexible, and responsive.
Perfect as usual. Lovely bedroom and perfect location close by the international organisations offices and the airport.

Absolutely great place to stay. Easy to find, very clean and comfortable, fast wifi, close to the UN premises and to the lake. Strongly recommended to anyone coming to Geneva either for working purposes or for vacation.

Nice made sure the check in process was quick and easy. The location is positioned well between the lively areas of Carouge and Geneva and made for enjoyable walks to those areas. The apartment was well sized for two guests, with a very comfortable bed and updated bathroom. Aside from the occasional noise outside late at night, this place was absolutely perfect and made for a great place for our three day holiday.

The key lock system is brilliant facilitated check-in, secured coming and going. The communication through AirBnB was reliable and knowing in advance the WIFW code was handy and helped with Check-in. The accommodation is central, and the Bus/Tram services to Geneva station and Geneva airport is good. There are several food stores in the surroundings (Aldi, Denner). Guest rules were helpful to find the kitchen always clean.

The appartment is cosy and very well located. The street is a bit busy so for us it was a bit hard to get a good night sleep (but we are light sleepers). The fact that the tram is right in front of the house is super convenient to visit and explore the city.
Wonderful, clean and spacious studio located near everything you need in Genève. I highly recommend it if you’re looking for an alternative to the expensive hotels. It was very clean and orderly.

For a first, this was a mind blowing experience. You really feel home with everything you need. You understand the owners love art and design. It seems like the « Parc des eaux-vives » is your garden given the proximity of it. I would definitely recommend it as a better alternative than hotels!

The place is lovely, well set up and close to public transport. Jeanne was a great host; super responsive and flexible, letting us pop our bags in prior to check in. The whole experience was made easy and simple for us. Lovely lovely place.

We had a wonderful few nights in Eric's apartment. It is well-appointed and comfortable. Pavel was helpful during check-in and was contactable during our stay although we didn't really need anything. The apartment is in a great location close to many bars, restaurants and supermarkets. It was good value for Geneva. As others have said, it's on a street that is quite happening at night but with the shutters down we were not at all bothered by noise and enjoyed being close to many restaurant options!
This was a great place to stay. Very close to the lake. Jean was very responsive and helpful. The place was very clean and very spacious. I do recommend it to anyone who wants to have a good stay.

I really enjoyed staying at Isaac's place. It's super close to a the station and the main town area and I was able to walk everywhere. From him home I went to many different places e.g. the movies, the comedy theatre, many tourist places. I did the "Free Walk Geneva" which was a totally incredible experience.

Isaac was really helpful and flexible. I travelled alone, so the space was enough. The apartment is located just a few minutes (if you’re are walking) from the train station and has just a great value considering Geneva is pretty expensive. I will definitely consider Isaac‘s place again, when I come back to Geneva.

Isaac's place was as described, centrally located, with things to see and do around. Isaac was responsive and flexible, easy to communicate with. Check in and check out went smoothly. The place is a good value for money, considering Geneva's rates and prices. I liked staying at Isaac's place.

Sarah is very helpful and was always available to help us. She kindly left a hairdryer which I requested before our arrival and also answered us immediately when I messaged. The flat is 10/10, it is cozy, clean, modern and its contrast with the old town of hermance makes it the most charming place I have ever been. We are looking forward for staying in the little house again. Thank you, Sarah! (Mariana and Raphael)
Enjoyed a lovely time in Geneva from the comfort of this space. Easy access to public transportation, excellent location, and very walkable. 10/10 would stay again.

Alex and Ruxandra's apartment was perfect!  The rooms are beautiful, comfortable, and everything we needed was available. I agree with the other reviewer who wrote that the place looks even better in person than in the pictures. Nice shower!! The location also couldn't be better.  A very short walk to the Geneva main train station, close to the lake and old town.  There are also lots of good restaurants a short walk away.  Alex and Ruxandra were great to work with; getting inside and checking out were both very simple.  Next time we're in Geneva we'll be back.

Our family spent 3 nights in Alex's flat between a rather busy tour of Prague and a hectic week of skiing. It was the perfect spot to recharge our batteries for a few days. Alex met us at the apartment and was very friendly and hospitable. The flat is lovely, comfortable and warm - and spacious by European standards so there was plenty of room for the 4 of us. We did some laundry which was a bonus. Water pressure in the shower was fabulous. The neighbourhood felt safe and extremely convenient i.t.o. restaurants and access to the lake. I was sorry that we didn't get to explore more of Geneva - we would happily stay at Alex's again if we ever return.
We had a lovely stay. The apartment was clean, well located, and exactly as described. Check-in was smooth and communication with the host was excellent. Would definitely recommend!

Fernando’s apartment is great! I can stay there really like my home with my son. Spacious with a nice kitchen and two bathrooms and two comfortable bed rooms. The apartment was exactly like in the pictures. It had a lot of details that made us feel super comfortable. The place was super clean and well equipped. This area is safe, calm and known for being a good neighborhood. I don’t have to worry about any security for small kids. There are many good parks around there and we can easily find a supermarket and shops. Thanks to Fernando and Maria, we were able to spend special holidays in Geneva. Definitely I would come back!
Nice apartment and really close to the train station/centre which was handy. Nice, clean apartment with lots of space!
Elizaveta‘s apartment is a beautiful home and the perfect place to spend some days in Geneva. Great location with a nice view - and the bed is SUPER comfortable!
Great place to stay in Geneva! Not too far from Old town. Lots of food options in the area. The water temperature in the shower is pretty inconsistent and no shower curtain. Overall would recommend

I had an amazing stay at Hülya’s house. Her son and her were very welcoming. The house was very clean and the bus is at 4 mins by walk ( dont’t forget to pay btw ) If I can comeback it will be without any hesitation !
Nice hotel, location was great being a 2 minute walk from the main train station and having public transportation right next to the hotel as well. You also don’t hear any outside noise when sleeping

Ben was extremely generous and communicative, and we felt welcomed from the minute we landed in Geneva. The place is centrally located, close to a supermarket and public transportation. Wonderful stay!
Thank you for all the helpful restaurants and place recommendations, save me time from googling haha~ The house was very neat and tidy which gives me a homey feeling while staying. Merci beaucoup!

Spotlessly clean, massive and comfortable bed, nicely updated, lots of light even though it’s ground floor, everything in the flat is perfectly laid out, thoughtful touches like sparkling water in the fridge and chocolates and tea-excellent place to stay for a business trip, and super responsive hosts.

Ultra convenient to the lake and restaurants. Super nice host and feeling really welcomed and comfortable in this flat with a lot of attention to details! Small flat but has everything a couple needs for a weekend trip.

Igor & Zeynab are great hosts -- and very responsive. Their apartment is very clean with a full kitchen and washer/dryer. It's on the ground floor, without much of a view, but has full length blinds (so that people walking into the building can't see in). They try hard to make sure you have everything you need, and it was definitely appreciated. The bed is also comfortable.

Great place to stay in Geneva. Close enough to the city if you want to go walk around. Lots of great shops in the area as well. Murat offered great recommendations and was very responsive prior to and during my stay. Highly recommend!
Paola is a great manage person making you feel at home, The property is in very good conditions with good neighbors and nice environment. Great location, close to sinagogue… Thanks Paola Alex

The room is clean, fully equipped and beautifully decorated with a fantastic window view and a great location that you can reach the lake within walking distance. We also received a warm welcome from the hostess and enjoyed delicious breakfast.
Beautifully clean, the apartment was easy to find thanks to the clear instructions and made great use of space. Great location near to the train made it easy to get to.

The appartment is just like the pictures and has great natural lighting. The bed is very comfortable and the neighbourhood peaceful. It is ideally situated close to train and tram making it very easy to go out and explore the city. We also appreciated having a full kitchen and bathroom. We felt right at home.
Excellent stay, the apartment is well located close to restaurants and the lake. Highly recommend.
The apartment was well located and very clean and stylish. We had a slight issue with the wifi code being incorrect but Marc directed us to where we could find the correct code. Good value for money

There was really nice apartment, very clean and comfortable. Everything were there what you need for convenient staying. Location is amassing, right after the door you will see very beautiful view and main promenade. A lot of shops and cafes near. Thank you very much Xavier for such a great apartment.

Cecilia's place is terrific. Excellent value, very comfortable, lots of character, and a great location. It's got two balconies, one overlooking the river! And Cecilia is a top-quality host – responsive, gracious, and accommodating. Highest recommendation
Philippe is a great host overall, super friendly and responsive. Great value for what was charged. The place was well maintained and never had any issues.
Communication was always efficient and quick, the apartment is super located to have a nice walk in both sides of Geneva. Also a plus for me that it was close to the train station.

A wonderful stay feeling at home! Checkin was very easy and with clear instructions. Anaïs was very clear and friendly. Her place is very clean and enjoyable. It feels like being at a friend's. The place is very next to the lake and nearby restaurants and shops. We spent 3 nights and were 4 adults in the flat and there was enough space for us to be at ease. I definitely recommend. Anaïs is a very friendly host! Thank you.

The studio was charming and neat. It's spacious with big windows. It has everything you need for a short stay. It is walking distance to all the attractions and to the train station. It is a steal for Geneva to have your own place like that!!!
We only stayed for one night, but it was very close to the train station, which was perfect for us. She also was very good about communicating and the apartment was very tidy when we checked in.

This flat was in an absolutely ideal location - close to the train station and close to the water spout! Had everything we needed. Also, cute area. There’s an Indian restaurant almost next door that was exactly what we hoped it to be!
lovely clean apartment close to train station and within a 10 minute walk to the lake
All good with Larissa's communication and with the location, I recommended!
I think everything was perfect for me - the location, every utility that I needed, price and most importantly forthcoming response from Fabrizio. Definitely worth coming back

An absolutely fabulous location, and an apartment to match. I could not be happier finding the apartment to use. Audrey was helpful and accommodating. I loved the little details of the apartment, from the upgraded windows to the hardware.

Very tidy and lovely loft studio equipped with everything you need. newly renovated with a nice bed, tidy kitchen, and a clean bathroom. Eric is a great host and there when you need him. stunning view of the lake and open farm land. I had a great stay :)

Ramona's place was a great home base for us to explore Geneva. The kitchen and washer/dryer are quite new and good quality, and we had everything we needed for meals and laundry over a three-week period. The windows make the place light and bright. Comfy beds. We didn't use the balcony because of the pigeons.. The location is fun -- quiet, but close to transit, groceries, restaurants and most importantly the lake! Ramona was very responsive.

Lovely stay in Geneva! The house was quiet, very well-equipped, and had a beautiful garden that made the stay extra relaxing. Everything was clean and comfortable. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in super easy. Highly recommend.

Bea was a good host! The room is big, clean, and has great views. The kitchen is big and clean. Bea gave great local recommendations, especially how to stay cool during the heat wave while I was there!

Mirabel's apartment is very cozy, she herself is a great, charming woman. The internet is fast, the inside is clean, and the furnishings are quite different but interesting. The kitchen is small but comfortable for cooking. The location is next to the lake, there are many shops around and public transport stops.

Mindaugas was the best host any traveler could hope for. Always helpful and easy going. The apartment was wonderful. Big, bright, great amenities and ideally located. I can not recommend this home and it’s host enough. You will not be disappointed. Thank you!

The apartament is beautiful and extremely well cared for. You can really notice the attention to detail in every space. It is airy, very clean, and pleasantly warm — which makes a big difference in Switzerland, especially during colder days. The kitchen is lovely and very well equipped, with all the tools you might need to cook comfortably. The hosts had some instructions on a kind of house manual. It was very clear and well organized, explaining how to use everything in the house. Nasira and Rashid were wonderful hosts. They were extremely kind and welcoming from the beginning, always willing to help and quick to answer any questions we had. Overall, we felt very well received and had a truly pleasant stay. We would absolutely recommend staying here.
I loved staying at this Airbnb, the location was near the mountains so the view was nice. And the bus stop is right in front so transport was very convenient. Would def stay again!

We had a great three night stay at Philippe’s place. As advertised It’s in a lively neighborhood, close to coffee, shops and restaurants, easy walking distance to Geneva Lake and other sites. The studio is quite small, but fine for two people for a short stay. Good alternative to Geneva’s steep hotel prices!

Philippe was a wonderful host and helpful. I was in the area for work and it was very easy to get around, very safe, easy to navigate, close to everything and had all the basics that you need for an Airbnb. I highly recommend staying at Philippe’s home, especially if you are in town for work or need an easy, comfortable and accessible location. Thank you Philippe!
Jonathan and Pauline were very friendly and accommodating to my father and young sister who came to visit Geneva. The apartment was perfect for what we needed

Katharina was a very responsive host and gave extremely clear instructions on how to find the keys and access the place. The apartment is great, it has a lot of space, is free of clutter and was very clean. The location is also quite convenient, only a short walk away from a train station and buses. I would definitely recommend staying here :)

Yohann is an outstanding host. Clear, thorough, detailed communication, explaining everything from Wi-Fi to access, location to amenities. Every time I communicated with Yohann, I received a quick, thorough, helpful response. The location is outstanding, just one block from the lake. Tons of restaurants and shops around. And the apartment was exactly as the pictures indicated- fully equipped for a few busy days exploring Geneva. I hope to stay here again the next time I am in Geneva.

The location of the apartment, the communication with Yohann and the check-in were all great. The apartment is a bit old/used and the towels could be replaced (stains, smelly kitchen cloth) - and sometimes there was a bit a strange smell (from the drain in the bathroom, I guess). All in all it was still a good stay but for the rather high price I'd like to mention these things anyways.

We stayed for one night before traveling to the rest of Switzerland. Very close to the lake and several restaurants. Convenient to parking. A bit warm given the time of year, fans helped to move the air enough and the cool air in the morning was nice. Overall would recommend for a stop in Geneva
The place is very nice and cozy. located in a very good part or geneva. close to the lake, park and supermarkets. we really enjoyed our stay
Enjoyed my weekend stay here with a few friends! Small space but great location and the place has everything that we needed.
The airbnb itself was nice and in a good location. We had some issues at the check in as we got the wrong address.

Agree with all of the reviews. Good location (walkable from train station) and seeing sites in Geneva. Apartment is way better than a small hotel room, so while having a living space might be nice - the sheer size of the apartment and large kitchen with 2BR makes this a great value. There is a great restaurant below the apartment (not a club) and while we could hear people on the street, the fans in the room covered that noise. For those visiting later in the summer with windows open - they may have more issues with the noise, but I‘ve found that’s often the case in many European cities. I wouldn’t hesitate to rebook this flat and neither should you.

I stayed here for a week attending a WHO meeting. Jack was so helpful and responsive. He ensure that I had all I needed fory stay. I wasn't prepared for winter as I came from a pacific island country. Jack even lend me his a jacket to help me cope with the winter. I highly recommend jacks place as it is affordable, clean and safe.

Julien was communicative, and responsive. The apartment is very nice and I liked the location. The bathroom is a little tight, fine for one person, but if you are a couple would need coordination between the two. There is an elevator, but it is small. I used it with no issue, though tight compared to elevators I am used to in the US.

Phillipe’s flat is amazing!! Perfect location in the city, walkable to everything, and an absolutely beautiful apartment. Phillipe is a stellar host—great communication & takes care of everything. Thanks for your hospitality & the chocolate!! Can’t wait to stay there again next year!

It’s a very good choice if you are only staying for a few days, wouldn’t really recommended it though for longer stays: no access to a washing machine, not equipped with many cookware. The difference to another apartment by Marc we stayed before in all those issues and the noise around make us choose the other one any day…

We had a great stay at the Anaïs’ apartment. The apartment was very clean, modern and well maintained. The check-in process was smooth and the host was responsive and very helpful. Perfect location and very comfortable!
Bilel is kind, very responsive and gave us clear instruction for check-in and check-out. The location of the Airbnb is perfect to explore Geneve and stay in a quiet residential area.
The location was good – close to everything one could need. The stay was fairly good; everything went smoothly and had no major issues.
We had a great stay at Severine's apartment. Beautifully decorated and in a great location, right next to the lake and the park, plus there's a bus stop on the corner.

My stay at Alexia and Greys's place was wonderful! It was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed. The hosts, both Alexia and Grey was friendly, empathic and helpful, and the location was perfect, specially for the people who work at CERN. Highly recommend :)
I had a lovely few days at the apartment. Sonia was a wonderful host and made me feel at home. Everything was very clean and comfortable. Thank you!

The apartment is fine and comfortable to stay in. There is a double bed, actually a sofa, which is transformed as a bed (it creaks a little bit), a small table and two chairs, kitchen equipment, microwave, kettle, small stove, no oven, but it is okay using the microwave instead, a small refrigerator with enough space for everything. The apartment is on the first floor, the window can be opened. There are roller blinds for windows outside, they are half closed, and can't be opened. So it is a little bit dark in the apartment, but you can use light. For me it wasn't a problem, because I spent just several hours in the evening at home. The bathroom is clean. The price is really good. The owner is a kind and pleasant person. Generally I liked the apartment and recommend everyone to stay here.

Our stay at Tatiana's was amazing. Communication was easy, and very easy & clear check in instructions. The apartment was beautifully decorated just as the photos show, all the amenities and linen were great quality, very spacious and had so many amazing restaurants within walking distance. Thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and would stay again.
Beautiful home and amazing host! It was super clean and we loved the location. Would definitely recommend staying here :)

This was my second time staying at Tatiana’s place and it felt like coming home. She is also a very lovely, friendly, and helpful host. Very clean and very spacious. The two full bathrooms were a huge plus! And the City of Carouge itself was very amazing with such easy access to all parts of Geneva. Thank you again, Tatiana!

What a joy it was to stay in Vitoria and Rita’s beautiful apartment. Very welcoming yet gave me plenty of privacy. Vitorio was a great help ahead of time with transfer options. Bed was super comfy and transport is literally at the front door. Appreciated being able to do my washing in between hikes and enjoyed sharing breakfast on my last morning. Highly recommend this stay.
Her house was very clean and comfortable. Public transportation was also very convenient, and the space is spacious because we can use the first and second floors alone.

Beautiful home in a peaceful, historic location. I wouldn’t hesitate to book again. Loved getting morning coffee and pastries each morning across the street, but you can easily cook and eat in instead. It’s the perfect set up for 5 people with generous space and very comfortable beds. Thank you for a wonderful stay and quick communication.
Great and very convenient location- short walk to the Gare and very central to cafes and restaurants. Nice decor!

The location of the apartment is great. There is also an elevator. A very modern, nicely designed apt. Comfortable main bed. Bunkbed very stable. A few details need improvement: we had no hand soap in the bathrooms; one reading lamp next to the main bed had no bulb; lots of stuff/equipment was stored in corners of main room (vacuum cleaner, fans, ironing board), cluttered - not like in photos (These items are better stored somewhere else. Suggest a wall hook for the ironing board.); host not available for communication on morning of check out. But on the whole a great location in a lovely area, price was normal for Geneva. With just a bit more attention to detail and decluttering the apartment would be worth a top rating.

This was a perfect spot for a stopover in Geneva. The flat has lovely big windows and backs onto beautiful green space so although it is centrally located remains so lovely and quiet. Easy access to public transit. The host was charming and easily accessible.

The apartment was very basic and did not meet our standards. Positives: Location - proximity to the Old Town The building has a lift Negatives: Slow responses from host Old and poorly equipped kitchen Dirty and damaged window blinds Uncomfortable beds The bathroom was very poor - shower was unusable Poor quality towels Very loud building works - drilling & banging from the lower floors during the day I have stayed at many Airbnb apartments over the years, this one is by far the worst - AVOID!
Nice location, and walkable to downtown very easily. The bed is not the most comfortable. Definitely keep the windows open in the summer time. Very happy to have had a lift.

It's a beautiful and clean flat and a professional environment. I came for work, so the area was ideal for me; it's residential. I also got along really well with the host, so it felt like we were flatmates for a few days. I would totally stay there again.

Very spacious with beautiful garden! a lot bigger and cleaner than the photos provided. Lots of cutleries and cooking tools with oven, airfryer, microwave and more. Highly recommend to visitors for palexpo!

Aisha is a great host and the apartment is same as the pictures. We been the first couple to stay at the place after its renovation. Area is wonderful and it has a bakery right below and a wine shop. Many restaurants are near by and bars. Migro , Coop and Denner are all in walking distance and Lake as well. Highly recommend this place. Thank you once again as well for the arrangements of the bus tickets :). Will come again when traveling to Geneva.

We rented the apartment for one day. Steеn was very kind and allowed us to stay a few hours longer, which we really appreciated. The apartment was clean and well maintained. A lovely highlight was the coffee and cookies left for us in the apartment — such a thoughtful and pleasant touch. We were also contacted via W by a representative who answered all our questions promptly, and it was especially nice that they communicated in our native language. Highly recommended!

Great flat, well presented in the centre of Geneva close to all the amenities and restaurants. Perfect for a city break. Aisha was very responsive and helpful both before and during our stay. Great little find
