I had a fantastic experience staying at this Airbnb. The place was exactly as described – clean, cozy, and very well-equipped. The bed was comfortable, the kitchen had everything I needed, and the Wi-Fi was fast and reliable. The location was perfect: close to public transportation, shops, and great restaurants. It was easy to get around and explore the area. Our host was incredibly friendly and responsive. They provided clear instructions for check-in. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting the area. Thank you for such a great experience!
Gorgeous quiet setting with lovely family. And so very easy to get into Geneva central and the airport.
Nice apartment with good links to the airport and a short walk to the lake. Perfect apartment for a short stay. Only issue was the tv not working but lots to do around the city so not really needed.
Really nice apartment - bigger than it looks in the photos so good for a group. Also easy to get around by bus and Fadel sorted out transport cards for us. And host was very communicative!

We liked our stay at the Marc’s place. The location is perfect for a short city overview, the apartment is nice and stylish, we had all supplies needed except wi-fi which was accessible only in one point of the apartment, keep this in mind if you will need it during your stay.

We really enjoyed our stay in Geneva. The apartment was authentic and well-located, making it easy to explore the city as a local. It was very easy to communicate and the host was very accommodating for our early check-in request.
Recommend this place for anyone living or staying in Satigny for any amount of time. Nearby the train station, nice spot, and Caroline knows the area.
Very comfortable place. Easy access by public transport, and 15 min from the city center. Easy check-in and check-out.
Nasser was an awesome host, very friendly and willing to share some great recommendations about the area. The place was well kept and clean. I highly recommend booking a stay with him.

The building is under construction. Iana had mentioned there 'maybe some noise due to reconstruction'. We reached relatively late at night, and realised there was scaffolding on the all around the building. In the morning about 8.30, we were woken up by violent hammering right outside. Some noise seemed like an understatement. The listing should have mentioned the scaffolding and pictures should have included that in the morning it could feel there was no privacy with workers right outside the window.

Mustafa is a great, reliable host. Teas, coffee, butter, some fruit provided. We advised him about kitchen utensils needed. Functional kitchen. Small apartment that was fine for 4 nights. Mustafa keeps a large coffee machine, a suitcase, his coats and personal toiletries in this apartment. There are 2 awkward , steep steps up into the bedroom/living area which are not a problem if you are careful at night. Be aware that you have neighbours which is fine if all is going well for them. Fabulous Lebanese restaurant on the street below!
Our stay was comfortable and everything was at a reachable distance. The host was extremely helpful to us. We would highly recommend this place for stay in Geneve.
Perfect location close to transportation and restaurants. the place was peace, clean and matched the description. I enjoyed my stay.
It was really a nice stay. They provided water, charger and so on, btw the room smells really good. It’s clean everywhere.

Nathalies stay is a great place to spend your time when in geneva. She welcomes you with a lot of warmth and information for you to experience in Geneva. The stay in itself is very organised and clean.
The Airbnb was great cute small room with an outdoor terrace. Host and family was friendly and happy to share local recommendations on the door or what to do. Would love to stay there again.
Nathalie was incredibly kind from the very beginning. We traveled with our pet, and she truly made us feel at home. I especially want to highlight her kindness and flexibility. Highly recommended!

The room was exactly as advertised and was very comfortable. The host Nathalie is extremely kind, welcoming and helpful. Nathalie gave us many directions around the city and local recommendations.i would 100% recommend to anyone staying in Geneva.
Great apartment for a short stay, all provided as per the advert and host was very supportive and responsive. Thanks!

Wow! I absolutely loved this Airbnb! It was spacious, it had good views of nature, the sounds of birds, and local Swiss living their lives! I absolutely loved the outdoor sitting area! I was able to watch the thunder and lightening storm safely! It had a lovely lounge area to relax in. The best part was the host! I appreciated the tour of how to use items in his home! He was very kind and helpful to answer all my questions on what trams to take! I highly recommend this Airbnb!
Very nice place and great view of the mountains from the balcony. Extremely clean and cosy and the host left chocolates for us upon arrival.
We had a great stay! The studio is very cozy in a perfect location and we appreciated a great communication and flexibility from the host :)
Easy to find from the station and good public transport around, we only stayed for one night so it was fine for what we needed but maybe a bit small if you were staying longer

Larissa's flat was extremely clean and essential things were provided. The space was enough for two people. The area was quiet, there's a shop right next to the building. The locals we met were remarkably friendly and helpful too. There were tram stops nearby and most places that we visited were near enough to walk or easily accessible by trams. Larissa answered my query pre-booking, she was friendly and helpful. I highly recommend Larissa's flat.

Perfect location for a short stay in central Geneva. Walking distance to station, UN, the lake, and center of town. Very reasonably priced and everything you need if you want an economical self-contained unit. Larissa was extremely helpful and even agreed to receive a package for me that arrived before I did. Thanks for a great stay!

Had a good stay at this beautiful apartment in Paquis! The place was clean, comfortable, and perfectly located—just a short walk from the lake and public transport. The host was welcoming and responsive. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Geneva!

The apartment has a great location, close to anything that you need! It is also easy to find and we got great instructions on how to get there! Tiny note: some things in the house are a bit overused, with signs that they need changing, like the toilet seat and power sockets, things that could be easily handled by the owner.

The place is pretty nice and close to the lake. Room was actually more spacious than it looks on the photos. We had a great stay. The host was nice and responsive to us too! The downside is that we came when the building was under construction so the entrance was a little bit hidden away, and the elevator to the room was not in good condition. The room's bathroom does not drain very well so we had water flooding the floor after showering.

I highly recommend this Airbnb! The location is perfect, close to local attractions yet quiet enough for a relaxing stay. The space is clean, cozy, and thoughtfully decorated, making it feel like a home away from home. The host is incredibly friendly and responsive, ensuring everything went smoothly. Great value for the price—definitely would stay here again!

We had a great stay :) The apartment is in a great location (central and very easy to get to everywhere in Geneva). Everything looks exactly like the pictures provided and it is nice to have the high ceiling and to be on the top floor (plus very easy access with the modern elevator)!

We ate a delicious lunch and buffet breakfast that were very well repaired. I was impressed with the mattress, sheets and pillows!! The steam room was a very welcome addition. The hotel is near to the train station and has a grocery store just across the street.
Lovely flat in a beautiful location, clean, bright, and with a lovely Sicilian restaurant in the same little street. Close to the lake. Perfect communication. Recommended.
Such a lovely clean apartment that was homey and felt very safe. The area is peaceful and residential and a perfect base for a solo female traveller. I would definitely recommend to stay here :)
Perfect ! Gaïa answers fast and is very kind, the localisation of the appartment is perfect for transport.

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment! It was clean, cozy, and perfectly located near all the attractions, 2 minute walk to Geneva Cornavin Train Station, Large Department Store 'Manor' accross the road from the apartment. The host was friendly and responsive, making our stay even more enjoyable. Highly recommend for a short getaway! Thanks Ajay..

This is a wonderful apartment with nice views of the bustling city street and a short walk to the lake. Unbeatable access to multiple trams/buses just out the front door and a short walk to the train station. Ajay was very responsive and the place is spacious. Great apartment!

This is for Smokers only. Non-smokers beware… I believe a chain smoker was there prior to us. Could not air out by opening windows. Even after sleeping a night, could still smell strongly the smoke in the morning. Bathroom very old, stained black. Old visible plumbing. Contact was good. Easy to enter and leave. Good cost effective central location if you like smoking indoors;)

The location was an easy, 15 minute walk downhill to the beautiful waterfront, and a lovely public garden. From there you have access to the boardwalk area along lake Geneva. The home was well stocked with amenities and exactly as advertised.
Located right in the city center, convenient for reaching the train station, bus stops, and the airport. Situated on the 4th floor with an elevator, the room is tidy and clean.

Super comfortable and spacious room! Has a little balcony to enjoy in good weather. The kitchen and bathrooms were clean and well maintained. Well insulated from the street noise. Will definitely be back!

The location is super convenient and really close to the airport, which made everything so easy! I highly recommend it for a short stay – they have all the equipment you need. Plus, the host was really friendly and gave clear directions. Definitely a great choice!

Everything was lovely. Umbelina welcomed us personally. So loved that, not something you get to see at all airbnbs. Also quite accommodating. Great views and space. Quite private. Although bit of a walk from the bus station especially if you have lot of luggage.

We were warmly welcomed by Umbelina, who was exceptionally kind, friendly, and always willing to assist with our questions. We particularly appreciated her generous offer of complimentary laundry service, which made our stay even more convenient. The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and equipped with all the necessary amenities. We truly enjoyed our stay and felt very much at home throughout our visit. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a welcoming and comfortable place to stay.
Very city but very cute and cozy! The shower is particularly nice 👌

Everything is perfect, the house is cozy , the location is nice 5 mins walk from the train station and the kitchen have everything you need but please take note for all the elderly or family with kids you will need to climb the stairs it is at level 5

we stayed a few days at Cliff's and it suited us so well, the place is very centrally located and in the backstreets around it there are lots of local gems. the room is large and airy and the kitchen well equipped. Having to share a bathroom with the other room did not interfere with our stay at all. very close by is also a great bike shop in case you want to rent cycles for your stay which I highly recommend!
Cliff is very friendly and willing to response us. The room, kitchen and toilet are extremely clean, just like the photos he shown. Highly recommended:)
Great place to stay at. Close to Cornavin and the lake. Good food nearby. Ahmad was a great host.

Beautiful apartment with amazing view from balcony, easy to get inside with good access to shops and close to station. The apartment is really nice, clean and has kitchen access as well as a living area. The host was amazing and very friendly. Couldn’t have had a better place to stay!

I’ve spent 4 weeks in this room. Perfectly comfortable and nothing to complain. - Quick and kind response for my inquiries - Spacious and nicely cleaned rooms with the kitchen everything equipped - Walking distance to UN organizations and Gare Cornavin - Beautiful neighborhood with a lot of green with 2 supermarkets conveniently located - Very quiet at night I thank so much to the owners and definitely come back if I have next trip

I liked the flat: clean, comfortable layout, and all the necessary equipment is available. The location is excellent - close to a grocery store. The owners are friendly and quickly answer questions. Repair fresh, furniture in good condition. In general - I recommend!
Extraordinary studio apartment in the heart of the city. Isabel was a fabulous host and my stay exceeded all expectations.

The apartment is very close to the railway station and the bus station. The area is clean and nice. The room was very clean and relatively comfortable. There was a small kitchen corner with a kettle, plates, and glasses. It would be great to add spoons and a knife. The address given on Airbnb was incorrect. It indicated a block of flats opposite the studio itself. The owner could not arrange a Geneva travel card, so I had to pay for all public transport in the canton of Geneva. It is likely that the guest will fix the problem in the future. The wifi was O.K., the bathroom was very clean and comfortable. To sum up, the studio is worth the money.

Good value in Geneva, close to public transportation and easy access to the airport. Check in requires you to go to a separate address first to get the keys, but this isn't required upon check out. Host was minimally communicative, and an address confusion was met with a curt "please read instructions." Great stay if you know the area, maybe not so much for visitors!

It was our first time in Switzerland and Kim and Jm were beyond welcoming and accommodating hosts. The apartment is tucked away in a quiet corner of Geneva and was beautiful, peaceful, and clean. It included a private outdoor space and a convenient parking spot. We explored Geneva and also took a short trip to Annecy, and really enjoyed the location. To say Kim and Jm were good hosts is an understatement - when we accidentally left a few items behind, they were kind enough to express mail them at our next location so we could get them before leaving the country. We would highly recommend a stay here!!

Armando’s place was exactly what I needed for my short stay in the city. While I didn’t meet him in person he was very helpful and easy to communicate with. Definitely would stay again and recommend to other travelers!
Excellent location, very clean and a good value for the area.

I rented the apartment at the last minute, and Baptiste not only welcomed me very kindly but also allowed me to check in early, for which I’m truly grateful. The apartment is very cozy, everything is newly purchased and clean, and I felt very comfortable staying there. Highly recommended!

Nice place to stay, Isabelles mother who is on property is very lovely and it's great for a short stay. I was mostly in geneva to work at the WHO archives, but I found that the location is great if you want to get into town or even wander down yourself as well. I was sort of surprised to learn I could only use the kitchen to make snacks and reheat things. I was hoping to be able to make meals as geneva is expensive. But aside from that the airbnb was perfect and I'd love to stay in the future
Ana Paula is a great host and her room is the perfect place to stay if you are in Geneva!
The room is spacious and well-located. The landlord is very enthusiastic and patiently responds to all our inquiries. Nice experience.
Good persons , polite and very communicative. The house is very comfortable and the environment is very wonderful.

Thank you for hosting us Lou, it was a lovely and inspiring stay. Your hospitality and kindness will be remembered for long. We were very lucky to find your apartment, full of art and peace. A great selection of little details and wisdom that helps to appreciate life. The balcony is great at night. Very convenient location. Comfortable bed! Would love to stay there again one day, generous price.

Nice location, very clean. Good to know: Be aware that there is no wifi, so if you travel from abroad plan accordingly. The towels provided are very small and scarce. Just a few hand towels, no body-sized towel was provided. The bed mattresses lie directly on the floor.
Nice, comfortable flat in a quiet and central neighborhood. We appreciated that we could use the parking. And the very responsive and kind host. Would love to come back!
The house was extremely clean and spotless. The apartment is quite large, with a wonderful balcony, well decorated, and cozy. I rented it for a few weeks and had an amazing experience. Thank you!!

Marie-Caroline was a fantastic host, friendly, flexible and proactive. She was very responsive and ensured that everything was smooth every step of the way. The place was beautiful and right in the middle of old Carouge, close to public transport, stores and restaurants and, had a parking. The place remained cool and comfortable during the heatwave. We would definitely come back and highly recommend !

This home is absolutely perfect for us, so clean, comfortable, quiet and we felt welcomed and right at home. The balcony was a lovely place to unwind after our busy days. Kavitha was so very kind and helpful with great tips on local amenities and activities. The neighbourhood was so clean and safe, with 2 grocery stores nearby. We took the bus a lot to get around Geneva and the bus stops were very close and convenient too. A very perfect place to stay in, thank you Kavitha, so very much!
Small studio very well located .and cozy . It has everything you need and the host is very kind . I recommend
Host was helpful in providing a solution to parking . The apartment is comfortable and clean. Highly recommend.

Recent stay in Geneva was absolutely wonderful — a perfect location right in the heart of the city, just near to the train station, surrounded by shops and restaurants, with a beautiful balcony view to top it all off.

We stayed here for 3 nights after our previous Airbnb was unexpectedly canceled, and the host was very accommodating on short notice. Communication was easy through the Airbnb app, which helped since we don’t speak French or Spanish fluently. The king-size bed was very comfortable, and the private deck was a nice bonus. The shared bathroom and kitchen had everything we needed. Great location—just a 10 minute walk to the train station, with tram and metro access right outside. Plenty of cafés, bakeries, and grocery stores nearby. The area felt safe, and the host was quiet and respectful of our privacy. We’d happily recommend it to others. Thank you, Dave & Christine
Leylas place is the perfect location in Geneva close to everything and beautifully made up.
Leyla's place was modern and had excellent amenities. The location is also great!
The room and toilet were very clean. The appartment is not far away from the city center. The host was ver nice and communicative.

This accommodation was exactly as described and I loved the modernized keyless entry access. The entire space was very clean and the front desk was very helpful whenever I needed assistance. The host answered any questions that I had in a timely manner and I was very appreciative of that. I spent a month there and I have no regrets. It was worth every penny and it would definitely be my first option if I am to visit Geneva again
The place was good, clean and I would love to stay in the next time
The apartment could definitely be cleaner, especially the carpet in the room and the bathroom glass. Also, it’s much smaller than what the pictures are showing.
This was a great apartment to stay in. The location is excellent, It’s also close to the downtown and includes private parking

Marc’s place was absolutely beautiful and it had everything that you might need (we were there only for several days, but it seemed to be fully equipped for a longer stay, too). The space was quite bright and luxurious. The location was convenient, though it must be noted that we were lucky that the renovations on the opposite side of the street were paused for New Year. It was a bit cold for our preference, but it wasn’t too bad. The view of the lake from the balcony was enough to compensate for any inconveniences.

The apartment photo is very accurate. Basic facilities, very clean and a comfortable bed. Very conveniently situated close to the lake on a quiet street. Nearby cafes and supermarket, and the Paulo Italian restaurant opposite is very good. The old time is a 5 minute walk away. Excellent transport system in Geneva. Although the City Pass does not come free if you are in an Air B and B, generally transport is inexpensive.

The host was incredibly accommodating and responsive, making adjustments to suit my needs which I really appreciated. The house itself was impeccable—clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. All instructions are given with a video too so you will not be lost on how to enter the place. Highly recommended. Thank you Sueli!
Lovely host and place, easy to commute to the airport! Would highly recommend if you need a room near Genava airport

Excellent and comfortable stay. The apartment is conveniently located close to the main station and easily accessible from the airport. The neighborhood is pleasant and well connected to both the lake and the city center. The apartment itself is very beautiful, with a lovely balcony view. It was clean, well equipped, and had everything needed for a relaxing stay. Highly recommended.

I am very happy with my stay at Melanie’s house. Perfect location nearby the lake, COOP Supermarket downstair, restaurants nearby. Room is tidy with toilet and shower next. They are polite and friendly ;))

The place is very superb and rightly priced free from the city noise and also very ease to navigate the way from the City centre ,the place feels home away from home ,my next visit in Geneva this will be the first to consider for my accomodation.

Jeff was a great host to us for the night. He was flexible with us and was very friendly. He has a wonderful house, and the room was very nice to stay in. Everything was very clean and smelled amazing. If I am in Geneva again I will be staying here again.

This is such a great apartment to spend up to a week in. Cristina is a friendly and helpful host who provided great instructions but also really useful recommendations. The apartment is clean, tidy, clutter free and very well equipped including with a fan for the hot days we had. Really enjoyed it, thank you!

Such a great place to stay! Wonderful location, beautiful building surrounded by stunning scenery. It was easy to walk to all the tourist attractions and still find some cute local shops and restaurants. Studio was clean and host was responsive. Wifi didn’t work for us but it didn’t matter because we were out travelling most of the time there. 10/10
